body.text: SaSū(C) 0
body.translated_text: Blessings! Homage to all <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bodhisattvas</s>!

body.text: svastiḥ! namaḥ sarvabuddhabodhisatvebhyaḥ!
SaSū(C) 1
body.translated_text: Thus have I heard: At one time, the <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling in <s>Rājagṛha</s>, on <s>Gṛddhrakūṭa</s> (Vulture Peak) mountain, with a great assembly of <s>bhikṣus</s>;

body.text: evaṃ mayā śrutam: ekasmin samaye bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati sma / gṛddhrakūṭe parvate mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena;
SaSū(C) 2
body.translated_text: together with twenty-two thousand <s>bhikṣus</s>. Namely: the venerable <s>Ājñātakauṇḍinya</s>, the venerable <s>Mahāmaudgalyāyana</s>, the venerable <s>Śāradvatīputra</s> (<s>Śāriputra</s>), the venerable <s>Mahākāśyapa</s>, the venerable <s>Rāhula</s>, the venerable <s>Bakkula</s>, the venerable <s>Bhadravāsa</s>, the venerable <s>Bhadraśrī</s>, the venerable <s>Nandaśrī</s>, the venerable <s>Jāṅgula</s>, the venerable <s>Subhūti</s>, the venerable <s>Revata</s>, the venerable <s>Nandasena</s>, and the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>; with twenty-two thousand <s>bhikṣus</s> headed by these.

body.text: 1. sārdhaṃ dvāviṃśatibhir bhikṣusahasraiḥ. 2. tadyathā āyuṣmatā cājñātakauṇḍinyena, 3. āyuṣmatā ca mahāmaudgalyāyena, 4. āyuṣmatā ca śāradvatīputreṇa, 5. āyuṣmatā ca mahākāśyapena, 6. āyuṣmatā ca rāhulena, 7. āyuṣmatā ca bakkulena, 8. āyuṣmatā ca bhadravāsena, 9. āyuṣmatā ca bhadraśriyā, 10. āyuṣmatā ca nandaśriyā, 11. āyuṣmatā ca jāṅgulena, 12. āyuṣmatā ca subhūtinā, 13. āyuṣmatā ca revatena, 14. āyuṣmatā ca nandasenena, 15. āyuṣmatā cānandena; 16. evaṃpramukhair dvāviṃśatibhir bhikṣusahasraiḥ.
SaSū(C) 3
body.translated_text: And with sixty-two thousand <s>bodhisattvas</s>. Namely: the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Maitreya</s>, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Kumāraśrī</s>, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Kumāravāsin</s>, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Kumārabhadra</s>, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Anūna</s>, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Mañjuśrī</s> the princely youth, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Samantabhadra</s>, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Sudarśana</s>, and the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Bhaiṣajyarāja</s>; with sixty-two thousand <s>bodhisattvas</s> headed by these.

body.text: dvāṣaṣṭibhiś ca bodhisatvasahasraiḥ, 2. tadyathā maitreyeṇa ca bodhisatvena mahāsatvena, 3. sarvaśūreṇa ca bodhisatvena mahāsatvena, 4. kumāraśriyā ca bodhisatvena mahāsatvena, 5. kumāravāsinā ca bodhisatvena mahāsatvena, 6. kumārabhadreṇa ca bodhisatvena mahāsatvena, 7. anūnena ca bodhisatvena mahāsatvena, 8. maṃjuśriyā ca kumārabhūtena bodhisatvena mahāsatvena, 9. samantabhadreṇa ca bodhisatvena mahāsatvena, 10. sudarśanena ca bodhisatvena mahāsatvena, 11. bhaiṣajyarājena ca bodhisatvena mahāsatvena; 12. evaṃpramukhair dvāṣaṣṭibhir bodhisatvasahasraiḥ
SaSū(C) 4
body.translated_text: And with sixty-two thousand divine sons (<s>devaputra</s>). Namely: the divine son <s>Arjuna</s>, the divine son <s>Bhadra</s>, the divine son <s>Subhadra</s>, the divine son <s>Dharmaruci</s>, the divine son <s>Candanagarbha</s>, the divine son <s>Candanavāsin</s>, and the divine son <s>Candana</s>; with sixty-two thousand divine sons headed by these.

body.text: 1. dvāṣaṣṭibhiś ca devaputrasahasraiḥ, 2. tadyathā arjunena ca devaputreṇa, 3. bhadreṇa ca devaputreṇa, 4. subhadreṇa ca devaputreṇa, 5. dharmarucinā ca devaputreṇa, 6. candanagarbheṇa ca devaputreṇa, 7. candanavāsinā ca devaputreṇa, 8. candanena ca devaputreṇa; 9. evaṃpramukhair dvāṣaṣṭibhir devaputrasahasraiḥ //
SaSū(C) 5
body.translated_text: And with eight thousand divine maidens (<s>devakanyā</s>). Namely: the divine maiden <s>Mṛdaṅginī</s>, the divine maiden <s>Prāsādavatī</s>, the divine maiden <s>Mahātmasaṃprayuktā</s>, the divine maiden <s>Varṣaśrī</s>, the divine maiden <s>Padmaśrī</s>, the divine maiden <s>Prajāpativāsinī</s>, the divine maiden <s>Balinī</s>, and the divine maiden <s>Subāhuyuktā</s>; with eight thousand divine maidens headed by these.

body.text: 1. aṣṭābhiś ca devakanyāsahasraiḥ, 2. tadyathā mṛdaṃginyā ca devakanyāyā, 3. prāsādavatyā ca devakanyāyā, 4. mahātmasaṃprayuktayā ca devakanyāyā, 5. varṣaśriyāyā ca devakanyāyā, 6. padmaśriyāya ca devakanyāyā, 7. prajāpativāsinyā ca devakanyāyā, 8. balinyā ca devakanyāyā, 9. subāhuyuktayā ca devakanyāyā, 10. evaṃpramukhair aṣṭābhir devakanyāsahasraiḥ;
SaSū(C) 6
body.translated_text: And with eight thousand <s>nāga</s>-kings. Namely: the <s>nāga</s>-king <s>Apalāla</s>, the <s>nāga</s>-king <s>Elapatra</s>, the <s>nāga</s>-king <s>Timiṅgila</s>, the <s>nāga</s>-king <s>Kumbhasāra</s>, the <s>nāga</s>-king <s>Kumbhaśīrṣa</s>, the <s>nāga</s>-king <s>Sunanda</s>, the <s>nāga</s>-king <s>Suśākha</s>, and the <s>nāga</s>-king <s>Gavaśīrṣa</s>; with eight thousand <s>nāga</s>-kings headed by these.

body.text: 1. aṣṭābhiś ca nāgarājasahasraiḥ, 2. tadyathā apalālena ca nāgarājñā, 3. elapatreṇa ca nāgarājñā, 4. timiṅgilena ca nāgarājñā, 5. kuṃbhasāreṇa ca nāgarājñā, 6. kuṃbhaśīrṣeṇa ca nāgarājñā, 7. sunandena ca nāgarājñā, 8. suśākhena ca nāgarājñā, 9. gavaśīrṣeṇa ca nāgārājñā; 10. evaṃpramukhair aṣṭābhir nāgarājasahasrais.
SaSū(C) 7
body.translated_text: They all approached the great city of <s>Rājagṛha</s>, <s>Gṛddhrakūṭa</s> mountain, and the <s>Bhagavān</s> <s>Śākyamuni</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One. Having approached, they bowed their heads at the feet of the <s>Bhagavān</s>, circumambulated the <s>Bhagavān</s> three times, and stood before the <s>Bhagavān</s>.

body.text: te sarve yena rājagṛhaṃ mahānagaraṃ yena gṛddhrakūṭaḥ parvato yena ca bhagavāṃ cchākyamunis tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhas tenopasaṃkrāntā upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasābhivandya bhagavantaṃ triṣpradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhagavataḥ puratas tasthire.
SaSū(C) 8
body.translated_text: And the <s>Bhagavān</s> acknowledged them through silence.

body.text: bhagavāṃś ca tūṣṇībhāvenādhivāsayati sma.
SaSū(C) 9
body.translated_text: Then the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, having risen from his seat, arranged his upper robe over one shoulder, placed his right knee on the ground, extended his palms toward the <s>Bhagavān</s>, and said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>:

body.text: atha khalu sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatvaḥ utthāyāsanād ekāṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ kṛtvā dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya yena bhagavāṃs tenāṃjaliṃ praṇamayya bhagavantam etad avocat:
SaSū(C) 10
body.translated_text: 'Many <s>koṭīs</s> (tens of millions) of gods, <s>koṭīs</s> of celestial maidens, <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>bodhisattvas</s>, and many <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>śrāvakas</s> (hearers) have assembled and are seated for hearing the <s>Dharma</s>, O <s>Bhagavān</s>. Therefore, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, I would ask the <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, Perfectly Awakened One about a certain matter, if the <s>Bhagavān</s> would grant me the opportunity to have my question answered.' When this was said, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said to the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s>: 'You always have the opportunity to ask a question, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>. Ask, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, whatever you wish; I shall satisfy your mind with the answer to each and every question.' When this was said, the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s> said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'Is there, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, a <s>dharma</s>-discourse, upon hearing which the five <s>ānantarya</s> (heinous) <s>karmas</s> of all beings go to complete exhaustion, and other <s>karmāvaraṇas</s> (karmic obscurations) will be exhausted, and [beings]

body.text: 1. bahvyo bhagavan devakoṭyo 'psarakanyākoṭyo bodhisatvakoṭyaḥ bahvyo bhagavaṃ cchrāvakakoṭyaḥ sannipatitāḥ sanniṣaṇṇā dharmaśravaṇāya. 2. tasmāt tarhi bhagavaṃ pṛccheyam ahaṃ tathāgatam arhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhaṃ kaṃcid eva pradeśaṃ, sacen me bhagavān avakāśaṃ kuryāt pṛṣṭapraśnavyākaraṇāya. 3. evam ukte bhagavāṃ sarvaśūrasya bodhisatvasyaitad avocat: nityakṛtyas te sarvaśūrāvakāśaṃ praśnaṃ paripṛcchanāya. pṛccha tvaṃ sarvaśūra yad yad evākāṃkṣasy ahaṃ te tasya tasyaiva pṛṣṭapraśnasya vyākaraṇena cittam ārādhayiṣye. 4. evam ukte sarvaśūro bodhisatvo bhagavantam etad avocat: asti bhagavaṃ saddharmaparyāyo yaṃ śrutvā sarvasatvānāṃ paṃcānantaryāṇi karmāṇi niravaśeṣeṇa kṣayaṃ gacchante, tathānye ca karmāvaraṇāḥ kṣīṇā bhaviṣyanti, kṣipraṃ cānuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhim abhisaṃbuddhyante?
body.translated_text: will quickly attain unsurpassed perfect awakening (<s>anuttarā samyaksaṃbodhi</s>)?'

body.text: SaSū(C) 11
body.translated_text: When this was said, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said to the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s>: 'Excellent, excellent, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, that you consider this matter worthy of asking the <s>Tathāgata</s>. Therefore, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, listen well and carefully, and pay attention — I shall speak to you.'

body.text: evam ukte bhagavān sarvaśūraṃ bodhisatvaṃ mahāsatvam etad avocat: sādhu sādhu sarvaśūra yas tvaṃ tathāgatam etam arthaṃ paripraṣṭavyaṃ manyase. 2. tena hi tvaṃ sarvaśūra śṛṇu sādhu ca suṣṭhu ca manasikuru bhāṣiṣye 'haṃ te.
SaSū(C) 12
body.translated_text: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>!' — the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s> listened attentively to the <s>Bhagavān</s>.

body.text: evaṃ bhagavann iti sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhagavataḥ pratyaśrauṣīd.
SaSū(C) 13-14
body.translated_text: The <s>Bhagavān</s> said this to him: 'There is, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, a <s>dharma</s>-discourse called the <s>Saṃghāṭa</s> (Accumulation); it shall circulate in <s>Jambudvīpa</s> at this time. Whoever, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, shall hear this <s>Saṃghāṭa dharma</s>-discourse — their five <s>ānantarya karmas</s> will go to complete exhaustion, and they will become irreversible (<s>avaivartika</s>) from unsurpassed perfect awakening.'

body.text: bhagavān asyaitad avocat: asti sarvaśūra saṃghāṭo nāma dharmaparyāya; etarhi jambudvīpe pracariṣyati. 2. yaḥ kaścit sarvaśūremaṃ saṃghāṭaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śoṣyati, tasya paṃcānantaryāṇi karmāṇi parikṣayaṃ yāsyanti, 3. avaivartikāś ca bhaviṣyanty anuttarāyā samyaksaṃbodheḥ.
SaSū(C) 15
body.translated_text: 'What do you think, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>? Will that being who hears this <s>Saṃghāṭasūtra dharma</s>-discourse produce a mass of merit equal to the mass of merit of a single <s>Tathāgata</s>? It should not be viewed thus, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>.'

body.text: tat kiṃ manyase sarvaśūra, ya imaṃ saṃghāṭasūtraṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śroṣyati, yathaikasya tathāgatasya puṇyaskandhas tathā tāvantaṃ puṇyaskandhaṃ sa satva prasaviṣyatīti? naivaṃ sarvaśūra draṣṭavyaṃ.
SaSū(C) 16
body.translated_text: The <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'Then how, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, should it be viewed?' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Those beings, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, will produce a mass of merit equal to the mass of merit of <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, Perfectly Awakened Ones equal in number to the sands of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> River. Those, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, who hear this <s>Saṃghāṭa dharma</s>-discourse — they shall all become irreversible from unsurpassed perfect awakening; they shall all see the <s>Tathāgata</s>; they shall all become seers of the <s>Tathāgata</s>; they shall all attain unsurpassed perfect awakening; they shall be invincible by <s>Māra</s> the evil one; they shall all attain wholesome <s>dharmas</s>. Those, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, who hear this <s>Saṃghāṭasūtra</s> — they shall all know arising and cessation.'

body.text: sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: yathā kathaṃ punar bhagavan draṣṭavyaṃ? 2. bhagavān āha: yathā gaṃgānadīvālukāsamānāṃ tathāgatānāṃ arhatāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāṃ puṇyaskandhas, tāvantaṃ sarvaśūra te satvāḥ puṇyaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyanti; 3. ye sarvaśūra imaṃ saṃghāṭaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śroṣyanti, te sarve avaivartikā bhaviṣyanti anuttarāyāḥ samyaksaṃbodheḥ; 4. sarve ca tathāgataṃ drakṣyanti, sarve ca tathāgatadarśāvino bhaviṣyanti; 5. sarve cānuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhim abhisaṃbhotsyante; 6. adhṛṣyāś ca bhaviṣyanti māreṇa pāpīmatā: 7. te ca sarve kuśaladharmam anuprāpsyanti: 8. ye sarvaśūra imaṃ saṃghāṭasūtraṃ śroṣyanti, te sarve utpādanirodhaṃ jñāsyanti.
SaSū(C) 17
body.translated_text: Then all those <s>koṭīs</s> of gods, <s>nāgas</s>, humans, and celestial maidens, at that time and on that occasion, having risen from their seats, arranging their upper robes over one shoulder, placing their right knees on the ground, they all asked the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'How great, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, is the mass of merit of a single <s>Tathāgata</s>?'

body.text: 1. atha te sarve devanāgamanuṣyāpsarakanyākoṭyas, tena kālena tena samayenotthāyāsanebhyaḥ ekāṃsāny uttarāsaṃgāni kṛtvā dakṣiṇāni jānumaṇḍalāni pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya te sarve bhagavantaṃ paripṛcchanti sma: 2. kiyān bhagavann ekasya tathāgatasya puṇyaskandhaḥ?
SaSū(C) 18
body.translated_text: The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Listen, sons of good family, to the measure of the mass of merit of a single <s>Buddha</s>. Suppose that [beings numbering]

body.text: 1. bhagavān āha: śṛṇu kulaputrā ekasya buddhasya puṇyaskandhasya pramāṇaṃ. 2. tadyathā mahāsamudre udakabindavaḥ, yathā jaṃbudvīpe paramāṇurajaḥ, yathā gaṃgānadīvālikāsamāḥ satvās, te sarve daśabhūmipratiṣṭhitā bodhisatvā bhaveyuḥ; yac ca teṣāṃ bodhisatvānāṃ puṇyaskandham, ato bahutaraṃ puṇyaskandham ekasya buddhasya puṇyaskandham. 3. ataś ca te sarvaśūra satvā bahutaraṃ puṇyaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyanti ya imaṃ saṃghāṭaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śroṣyanti, yāvan na śakyaṃ gaṇanāyogena tasya puṇyaskandhasya paryantam adhigantuṃ. 4. yasya sarvaśūra tasmin kāle tasmin samaye etad vacanaṃ śrutvā mahān utsāho bhaviṣyati ...
body.translated_text: as many as the drops of water in the great ocean, as many as the atoms of dust in <s>Jambudvīpa</s>, as many as beings equal to the sands of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> River — suppose they were all <s>bodhisattvas</s> established on the ten stages (<s>bhūmi</s>); the mass of merit of those <s>bodhisattvas</s> — yet even greater than that is the mass of merit of a single <s>Buddha</s>. And, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, those beings will produce an even greater mass of merit — those who hear this <s>Saṃghāṭa dharma</s>-discourse — the extent of their mass of merit cannot be reached by any calculation. <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, whoever at that time and on that occasion, upon hearing these words, will experience great enthusiasm...'

body.text: SaSū(C) 19
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 19

body.text: 1. atha khalu sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhagavantam etad avocat: katame te bhagavan satvā ye dharmaparitṛṣitā bhaviṣyanti? 2. evam ukte bhagavān sarvaśūraṃ bodhisatvaṃ mahāsatvam etad avocat: dvāv imau sarvaśūra satvau dharmaparitṛṣitau. 3. katamau dvau? yadutaikaḥ sarvaśūra sarvasatvasamacittaḥ, dvitīyaḥ sarvaśūra yo dharmaṃ śrutvā sarvasatvānāṃ samaṃ prakāśayati.
body.translated_text: (1) Then indeed the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Sarvaśūra</s> said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'Which are those beings, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, who will be thirsty for the <s>Dharma</s>?' (2) When this was said, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said this to the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Sarvaśūra</s>: 'There are these two beings, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, who are thirsty for the <s>Dharma</s>.' (3) 'Which two? First, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, one who has equal mind toward all beings; second, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, one who, having heard the <s>Dharma</s>, teaches it equally to all beings.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 20
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 20

body.text: 1. sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: katamaṃ bhagavan dharmaṃ śrutvā sarvasatvānāṃ samaprakāśanā? 2. bhagavān āha: ekaḥ sarvaśūra dharmaṃ śrutvā bodhāya pariṇāmayati: yadā ca bodhāya pariṇāmayati tadā sarvasatvā dharmaparitṛṣitā bhaviṣyanti. 3. dvitīyaḥ sarvaśūra yo mahāyānam avagāhayati; sa nityaṃ dharmaparitṛṣito bhavati.
body.translated_text: (1) The <s>bodhisattva Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'What <s>Dharma</s>, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, having heard, does one teach equally to all beings?' (2) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'First, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, one who, having heard the <s>Dharma</s>, dedicates it toward <s>bodhi</s> (awakening): and when he dedicates it toward <s>bodhi</s>, then all beings will become thirsty for the <s>Dharma</s>. (3) Second, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, one who plunges into the <s>Mahāyāna</s> (Great Vehicle); he is always thirsty for the <s>Dharma</s>.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 21
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 21

body.text: atha te devanāgamanuṣyāpsarasakoṭya utthāyāsanād bhagavataḥ purataḥ prāṃjalayo bhūtvā bhagavantam etad avocan: vayaṃ bhagavan dharmaparitṛṣitāḥ; paripūrayatu bhagavān asmākaṃ sarvasatvānāṃ cāśām!
body.translated_text: Then those millions of gods, <s>Nāgas</s>, humans, and <s>Apsarases</s>, having risen from their seats and standing before the <s>Bhagavān</s> with palms joined, said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'We, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, are thirsty for the <s>Dharma</s>; may the <s>Bhagavān</s> fulfill our wish and the wish of all beings!'

body.text: SaSū(C) 22
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 22

body.text: 1. atha khalu bhagavāṃs tasyāṃ velāyāṃ smitaṃ prāduścakāra. 2. atha khalu sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatva utthāyāsanād yena bhagavāṃs tenāṃjaliṃ praṇamayya bhagavantam etad avocat: ko bhagavan hetuḥ kaḥ pratyayaḥ smitasya prāduṣkaraṇāya?
body.translated_text: (1) Then indeed the <s>Bhagavān</s>, at that moment, displayed a smile. (2) Then the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Sarvaśūra</s>, having risen from his seat, extending his palms toward the <s>Bhagavān</s> and bowing, said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'What is the cause, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, what is the condition for the display of this smile?'

body.text: SaSū(C) 23
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 23

body.text: atha khalu bhagavān sarvaśūraṃ bodhisatvaṃ mahāsatvaṃ āmantrayām āsa: ye sarvaśūra satvā ihāgatvā te sarve anuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhim abhisaṃbuddhyante; sarve te tathāgatagocarapariniṣpattaye pariniṣpadyante.
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Sarvaśūra</s>: 'All those beings, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, who have come here — they all will attain supreme perfect awakening (<s>anuttarā samyaksaṃbodhi</s>); they all will reach the completion of the domain of the <s>Tathāgata</s>.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 24
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 24

body.text: 1. sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: ko bhagavan hetuḥ kaḥ pratyayaḥ yad ete satvā ihagatvānuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhim abhisaṃbuddhyante? 2. bhagavān āha: sādhu sādhu sarvaśūra yas tvaṃ tathāgatam etam arthaṃ paripraṣṭavyaṃ manyase. iha sarvaśūra pariṇāmanāviśeṣo draṣṭavyaḥ.
body.translated_text: (1) The <s>bodhisattva Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'What is the cause, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, what is the condition that these beings, having come here, will attain supreme perfect awakening?' (2) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Excellent, excellent, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, that you think this matter should be asked of the <s>Tathāgata</s>. Here, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, the distinction of dedication (<s>pariṇāmanā</s>) should be seen.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 25
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 25

body.text: 1. bhūtapūrvaṃ sarvaśūrātīte 'dhvany asaṃkhyeyaiḥ kalpai ratnaśrīr nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho loko udapādi vidyācaraṇasaṃpannaḥ sugato lokavid anuttaraḥ puruṣadamyasārathiḥ śāstā devānāṃ ca manuṣyāṇāṃ ca buddho bhagavān.
body.translated_text: (1) 'In the past, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, in a former time, incalculable <s>kalpas</s> (aeons) ago, a <s>Tathāgata</s> named <s>Ratnaśrī</s> (Jewel-Glory), an <s>Arhat</s>, a Fully Awakened One, arose in the world — endowed with knowledge and conduct, a <s>Sugata</s>, a knower of the world, unsurpassed, a tamer of persons to be tamed, a teacher of gods and humans, a <s>Buddha</s>, a <s>Bhagavān</s>.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 26
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 26

body.text: tena khalu punaḥ sarvaśūra kālenāhaṃ māṇavako 'bhūvam. 2. ye satvāḥ sāṃprataṃ mayā buddhajñāne pratiṣṭhapitās te sarve tena kālena tena samayena mṛgā abhūvan. 3. tena ca kālena tena samayenāham evaṃ praṇidhānam akārṣaṃ: ye kecin mṛgāḥ sāṃprataṃ duḥkhena paripīḍitāḥ ete sarve mama buddhakṣetra upapadyeran, sarvāṃś ca tān ahaṃ buddhajñāne pratiṣṭhāpayeyam. 4. te ca mṛgās tad vacanaṃ śrutvā evaṃ vācam abhāṣanta: evaṃ bhavatu. 5. tena sarvaśūra kuśalamūlenaite satvā ihagatvānuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhim abhisaṃbhotsyante.
body.translated_text: (1) 'At that time, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, I was a young man. (2) Those beings whom I have now established in the knowledge of the <s>Buddha</s> — they were all deer at that time and season. (3) At that time and season, I made this aspiration (<s>praṇidhāna</s>): "May all those deer who are now afflicted with suffering be reborn in my <s>Buddha</s>-field, and may I establish them all in the knowledge of the <s>Buddha</s>." (4) Those deer, having heard that word...'

body.text: SaSū(C) 27
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 27

body.text: atha khalu sarvaśuro bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhagavato 'ntikād utsāhaṃ śrutvā bhagavantam etad avocat: kiyantaṃ bhagavaṃs teṣāṃ satvānāṃ āyuṣpramāṇaṃ bhaviṣyati? 2. bhagavān āha: aśīti kalpās teṣāṃ satvānām āyuṣpramāṇaṃ bhaviṣyati.
body.translated_text: Then the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Sarvaśūra</s>, having heard the encouragement from the <s>Bhagavān</s>, said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'How long, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, will the lifespan of those beings be?' (2) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'The lifespan of those beings will be eighty <s>kalpas</s> (aeons).'

body.text: SaSū(C) 28
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 28

body.text: 1. sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: kiṃ bhagavan kalpasya pramāṇaṃ? 2. bhagavān āha: śṛṇu kulaputra, tadyathāpināma sarvaśūra kaścid eva puruṣo nagaraṃ kārayed, dvādaśayojanāyāmavistāraṃ, ūrdhvena trīṇi yojanāni pramāṇaṃ; 3. tac ca nagaraṃ tilaphalakaiḥ paripūrṇaṃ kuryāt; 4. atha sa puruṣo varṣaśatasyātyayāt tatas tilaphalakaiḥ paripūrṇān nagarād ekaṃ tilaphalakaṃ bahir nikṣiped; anena paryāyeṇa sa puruṣaḥ sarvāṇi tāni tilaphalakāni kṣayaṃ kuryāt, tac ca nagaram amūlam apratiṣṭhānāṃ bhaven; na cādyāpi ca kalpaṃ kṣīyeta.
body.translated_text: (1) The <s>bodhisattva Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'What, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, is the measure of a <s>kalpa</s>?' (2) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Listen, O son of good family. Suppose, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, a certain man were to build a city, twelve <s>yojanas</s> in length and breadth, three <s>yojanas</s> in height; (3) and he were to fill that city completely with sesame seeds; (4) and then that man, after the passing of a hundred years, were to cast out from that city full of sesame seeds a single sesame seed; by this method...'

body.text: SaSū(C) 29
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 29

body.text: 1. punar aparaṃ sarvaśūra: 2. tadyathāpināma parvato bhavet, paṃcaviṃśad yojanāni pramāṇena, dvādaśa yojanāny ūrdhvena; 3. atha kaścid eva puruṣas tasya parvatasya pārśve gṛhaṃ kārayet; 4. sa dīrghasyādhvano varṣaśatasyātyayena kāśikena vastreṇaikavārāṃ parimārjayed; evaṃ kṛtvā tasya parvatasya kṣayo bhaven, na ca kalpaṃ kṣīyeta. etat sarvaśūra kalpasya pramāṇaṃ.
body.translated_text: (1) 'Furthermore, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>: (2) suppose there were a mountain, twenty-five <s>yojanas</s> in extent, twelve <s>yojanas</s> in height; (3) and a certain man were to build a house at the side of that mountain; (4) and after the passing of a hundred years on the long road, he were to wipe it once with a cloth of <s>Kāśi</s>; doing this, the mountain would be worn away, but the <s>kalpa</s> would not yet be exhausted. This, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, is the measure of a <s>kalpa</s>.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 30
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 30

body.text: 1. atha khalu sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatva utthāyāsanād, ekāṃsam uttarāsaṃgaṃ kṛtvā, dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya, yena bhagavāṃs tenāṃjaliṃ praṇāmya, bhagavantam etad avocat: 2. ekapariṇāmanayā bhagavann evaṃ bahu puṇyaskandhaṃ prasavati yad utāśītiḥ kalpān sukham āyuṣpramāṇaṃ bhaviṣyati; 3. kaḥ punar vādo yas tathāgataśāsane bahutaram adhikāraṃ kariṣyati?
body.translated_text: (1) Then the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Sarvaśūra</s>, having risen from his seat, having arranged his upper robe on one shoulder, having placed his right knee on the ground, and extending his palms toward the <s>Bhagavān</s> and bowing, said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: (2) 'By a single dedication (<s>pariṇāmanā</s>), O <s>Bhagavān</s>, such a great heap of merit is produced that [beings] will enjoy a lifespan of eighty <s>kalpas</s>; (3) what then need be said of one who will perform even greater service in the teaching of the <s>Tathāgata</s>?'

body.text: SaSū(C) 31
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 31

body.text: 1. bhagavān āha - śṛṇu kulaputra, ya imaṃ saṃghāṭaṃ sūtraṃ śroṣyati tasya caturaśītiḥ kalpasahasrāṇy āyuṣpramāṇaṃ bhaviṣyati. kaḥ punar vādo yaḥ saṃghāṭaṃ sūtraṃ likhiṣyati vācayiṣyati: sa sarvaśūra satvo bahutaraṃ puṇyaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyati. 3. yaḥ sarvaśūra prasannacittaḥ saṃghāṭaṃ sūtram adhyāśayena namaskariṣyati sa paṃcanavati kalpāṃ jātau jātismaro bhaviṣyati, 4. ṣaṣṭi kalpasahasrāṇi rājā cakravartī bhaviṣyati, dṛṣṭa eva dharme sarvaśūra sarveṣāṃ priyo bhaviṣyati, 6. na sa sarvaśūra śastreṇa kālaṃ kariṣyati, kākhordaṃ cāsya na kramiṣyati; maraṇakāle ca navati buddhākoṭyaḥ saṃmukhaṃ drakṣyati, 9. te ca sarvaśūra buddhā bhagavanta āśvāsayanti: mā bhaiḥ satpuruṣa, tvayā saṃghāṭaṃ sūtraṃ mahādharmaparyāyaṃ subhāṣitaṃ śrutaṃ śrutvā iyān puṇyaskandhaḥ prasūtaḥ. 10. te ca paṃcanavati buddhakoṭyaḥ pṛthak pṛthag lokadhātuṣu vyākariṣyanti. 11. kaḥ punar vādaḥ sarvaśūra ya imaṃ saṃghāṭasūtraṃ mahādharmaparyāyaṃ sakalasamāptaṃ vistareṇa śroṣyati.
body.translated_text: (1) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Listen, O son of good family. One who hears this <s>Saṃghāṭa Sūtra</s> — his lifespan will be eighty-four thousand <s>kalpas</s>. What then need be said of one who will copy, recite, or teach the <s>Saṃghāṭa Sūtra</s>? That being, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, will produce an even greater heap of merit. (3) One who, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, with a clear mind and firm resolve, pays homage to the <s>Saṃghāṭa Sūtra</s> — he will remember his past lives for ninety-five <s>kalpas</s>, birth after birth. (4) For sixty thousand <s>kalpas</s>...'

body.text: SaSū(C) 32
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 32

body.text: 1. atha khalu sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhagavantam etad avocat: ahaṃ bhagavan saṃghāṭasūtraṃ mahādharmaparyāyaṃ śroṣyāmi; kiyantaṃ bhagavan puṇyaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyāmi? 2. bhagavān āha: yāvanto gaṃgānadībālikāsamānāṃ buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ puṇyaskandhas, tāvantaṃ sarvaśūra sa satvaḥ puṇyaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyati.
body.translated_text: (1) Then the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Sarvaśūra</s> said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'I, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, will hear the <s>Saṃghāṭa Sūtra</s>, the great <s>dharmaparyāya</s> (discourse); how great a heap of merit will I produce, O <s>Bhagavān</s>?' (2) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'As great as the heap of merit of <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bhagavāns</s> equal in number to the sands of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> River — that much merit, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, will that being produce.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 33
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 33

body.text: 1. sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: yad ahaṃ bhagavan saṃghāṭasūtraṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śṛṇomi, nāhaṃ bhagavaṃs tṛptiṃ saṃjānāmi. 2. bhagavān āha: sādhu sādhu sarvaśūra yas tvaṃ dharmāṇāṃ tṛptiṃ na saṃjānāsi. aham api sarvaśūra dharmāṇāṃ tṛptiṃ na saṃjānāmi; kaḥ punar vādaḥ sarvaśūra yad bālapṛthagjanās tṛptiṃ jñāsyanti.
body.translated_text: (1) The <s>bodhisattva Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'When I, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, hear the <s>Saṃghāṭa Sūtra</s>, the <s>dharmaparyāya</s>, I do not, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, find satiation.' (2) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Excellent, excellent, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, that you do not find satiation with the <s>Dharma</s>. Even I, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, do not find satiation with the <s>Dharma</s>; what then need be said, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, of whether foolish ordinary beings will find satiation?'

body.text: SaSū(C) 34
body.translated_text: 1. <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, whatever son or daughter of good family generates faith in the <s>Mahāyāna</s> (Great Vehicle) shall not fall into ruin for a thousand <s>kalpas</s> (aeons); 2. for five thousand <s>kalpas</s> they shall not be reborn as an animal; 3. for twelve thousand <s>kalpas</s> they shall not have dull intelligence; 4. for eighteen thousand <s>kalpas</s> they shall not be reborn in remote borderlands; 5. for twenty thousand <s>kalpas</s> they shall be heroic in giving; 6. for twenty-five thousand <s>kalpas</s> they shall be reborn in the heavenly realms; 7. for thirty-five thousand <s>kalpas</s> they shall practice the holy life (<s>brahmacarya</s>); 8. for forty thousand <s>kalpas</s> they shall have gone forth from the household life; 9. for fifty thousand <s>kalpas</s> they shall be bearers of the <s>Dharma</s>; 10. for sixty-five thousand <s>kalpas</s> they shall cultivate the recollection of death; 11. for that son or daughter of good family, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, no sinful deeds shall accrue; 12. nor shall <s>Māra</s> the Evil One gain entry over them; they shall never be conceived in a mother's womb. 14. Those, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, who shall hear this <s>Saṃghāṭa</s> discourse on the <s>Dharma</s>, wherever they are reborn, for ninety-five incalculable <s>kalpas</s> they shall not fall into ruin. 15. For eighty thousand <s>kalpas</s> they shall retain what they have heard; 16. for a hundred thousand <s>kalpas</s> they shall refrain from taking life; 17. for ninety-nine thousand <s>kalpas</s> they shall refrain from false speech; 18. for thirteen thousand <s>kalpas</s> they shall refrain from divisive speech. 19. Rare are those beings, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, who shall hear this discourse on the <s>Dharma</s>.

body.text: 1. yaḥ kaścit sarvaśūra kulaputro vā kuladuhitā vā mahāyāne prasādaṃ janayiṣyanti, sa kalpasahasraṃ vinipātaṃ na gamiṣyati, 2. paṃca kalpasahasrāṇi tiryakṣurnopapatsyate, 3. dvādaśa kalpasahasrāṇi durbuddhir sa bhavisyati, 4. aṣṭādaśa kalpasahasrāṇi pratyantimeṣu janapadeṣu nopapatsyate, 5. viṃśati kalpasahasrāṇi pradānaśūro bhaviṣyati, 6. paṃcaviṃśat kalpasahasrāṇi devalokeṣupapatsyate, 7. paṃcatriṃśat kalpasahasrāṇi brahmacaryaṃ cariṣyati, 8. sa catvāriṃśat kalpasahasrāṇi niṣkrāntagṛhāvāso bhaviṣyati, 9. paṃcāśat kalpasahasrāṇi dharmadharo bhaviṣyati, 10. paṃcaṣaṣṭiḥ kalpasahasrāṇi maraṇānusmṛtiṃ bhāvayiṣyati, 11. tasya sarvaśūra kulaputrasya vā kuladuhitur vā na kiṃcit pāpakāni karmāṇi saṃvetsyante, 12. na ca tasya māraḥ pāpīmān avatāraṃ lapsyate, na jātu mātukukṣāv upapatsyate. 14. ye sarvaśūra imaṃ saṃghāṭaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śroṣyanti, te yatra yatropapatsyante tatra tatra paṃcanavatyāsaṃkhyeyaiḥ kalpair vinipātaṃ na gamiṣyanti. 15. aśītiḥ kalpasahasrāṇi śrutadharā bhaviṣyanti, 16. kalpaśatasahasraṃ prāṇātipātāt prativiratā bhaviṣyanti, 17. navānavati kalpasahasrāṇi mṛṣāvādāt prativiratā bhaviṣyanti, 18. trayodaśa kalpasahasrāṇi piśunavacanāt prativiratā bhaviṣyanti. 19. durlabhās te sarvaśūra satvā ya iman dharmaparyāyaṃ śroṣyanti.
SaSū(C) 35
body.translated_text: 1. Then the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Sarvaśūra</s> rose from his seat, arranged his upper robe over one shoulder, placed his right knee on the ground, joined his palms toward the <s>Bhagavān</s> (the Blessed One) in salutation, and spoke thus to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 2. How great a mass of demerit, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, will those beings generate who reject this discourse on the <s>Dharma</s>? 3. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: Great, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, is the mass of demerit generated from rejecting the true <s>Dharma</s>.

body.text: 1. atha khalu sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatva utthāyāsanād, ekāṃsam uttarāsaṃgaṃ kṛtvā, dakṣiṇaṃ jānumaṇḍalaṃ pṛthivyāṃ pratiṣṭhāpya, yena bhagavāṃs tenāṃjaliṃ praṇamya, bhagavantam etad avocat: 2. kiyantaṃ bhagavaṃs te satvā apuṇyaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyanti ya iman dharmaparyāyaṃ pratikṣepsyanti? 3. bhagavān āha: bahu sarvaśūra saddharmapratikṣepād apuṇyaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyati.
SaSū(C) 36
body.translated_text: 1. <s>Sarvaśūra</s> said: How great, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, will the mass of evil <s>karma</s> (action) be for those beings? 2. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: Enough, enough, <s>Sarvaśūra</s> — do not ask me about the mass of evil <s>karma</s>! 3. <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, one who would generate a hostile mind toward <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, Perfectly Awakened Ones equal in number to the sand grains of twelve <s>Gaṅgā</s> rivers, and one who would reject this <s>Saṃghāṭa Sūtra</s> discourse on the <s>Dharma</s> — this one will generate a far greater mass of evil, unwholesome <s>karma</s>. 4. Moreover, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, those who will generate a mind of hostility toward the <s>Mahāyāna</s> will generate an even greater mass of unwholesome [karma]

body.text: 1. sarvaśūra āha: kiyantaṃ bhagavan satvānāṃ pāpakaṃ karmaskandhaṃ bhaviṣyati? 2. bhagavān āha: alam alaṃ sarvaśūra, mā me pāpakaṃ karmaskandhaṃ paripṛccha! 3. yaś ca sarvaśūra dvādaśagaṃgānadībālikāsamānān tathāgatānām arhatāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānām antike duṣṭacittam utpādayed, yaś cemaṃ saṃghāṭasūtraṃ pratikṣiped, ayaṃ tato bahutaraṃ pāpakam akuśalaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyati. 4. ato 'pi sarvaśūra bahutaram akuśalaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyanti ye mahāyāne āghātacittam utpādayiṣyanti; dagdhās te sarvaśūra satvā dagdhā eva!
body.translated_text: ; those beings, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, are burnt — burnt indeed!

body.text: SaSū(C) 37
body.translated_text: 1. <s>Sarvaśūra</s> said: How, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, can those beings be liberated? 2. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: Just so, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>; 3. for example, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, suppose a certain man were to cut off the head of some being and then anoint it again with some medicine, or smear that head with honey, or sugar, or molasses, or ghee, or oil. 4. Could that being, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, be raised up again?

body.text: 1. sarvaśūra āha: kathaṃ bhagavaṃs te satvā śakyaṃ mocayituṃ? 2. bhagavān āha: evam eva sarvaśūra; 3. tadyathāpināma sarvaśūra kaścid eva puruṣaḥ kasyacit satvasya śīrṣaṃ cchiṃdyād tasya punaḥ kenacid bhaiṣajyena praliṃpen, mākṣikena vā śarkarayā vā guḍena vā ghṛtena vā tailena vā taṃ śīrṣaṃ pralepayet. 4. śakyaṃ sarvaśūra sa satvaḥ punar api utthāpayituṃ?
SaSū(C) 38
body.translated_text: 1. The <s>Bodhisattva Sarvaśūra</s> said: It is not possible, O <s>Bhagavān</s>! 2. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: 1. sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: na śakyaṃ bhagavan! 2. bhagavān āha:
SaSū(C) 39
body.translated_text: 1. Furthermore, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>: suppose there were a second man who struck another being with a sharp weapon, but could not take his life with a single blow; even so, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, a wound would arise in him; then, when medical treatment is applied, he is freed from the wound; 2. when he is freed, he remembers the suffering: 'Now I understand — never again will I commit sinful, unwholesome volitional actions.'

body.text: 1. punar aparaṃ sarvaśūra: tadyathāpināma dvitīyaḥ puruṣo bhavet; sa tīkṣṇena śastreṇāparasya satvasya prahāraṃ dadyāt: sa na śaknuyād ekaprahāreṇa jīvitād vyavaropayituṃ; kiṃ cāpi sarvaśūra tasya vraṇam utpadyeta; atha ca punar bhaiṣajyayogaṃ kartavyaṃ tadā vraṇāt parimucyate; 2. yadā parimukto bhavati tadā duḥkhaṃ smarati: aham idānīñ jānāmi, na kadācit punaḥ pāpakam akuśalaṃ karmābhisaṃskāraṃ kariṣyāmi.
SaSū(C) 40
body.translated_text: 1. Just so, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, when that man remembers the suffering in hell, he abandons all sin; 2. then he will turn to face all <s>dharmas</s> (teachings); 3. having turned to face all <s>dharmas</s>, he will accomplish the fulfillment of all wholesome <s>dharmas</s>. 4. For example, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, the parents of a dead man — they grieve and lament but cannot save him; 5. just so, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, foolish ordinary beings cannot accomplish either their own welfare or the welfare of others, like hopeless parents; 6. just so, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, those beings become hopeless at the time of death.

body.text: 1. evam eva sarvaśūra sa puruṣo yadā narake duḥkhaṃ smarati tadā sarvapāpaṃ parivarjayati, 2. tadā sarvadharmān āmukhīkariṣyati; 3. sarvadharmān āmukhīkṛtvā sarvakuśaladharmapāripūriṃ kariṣyati. 4. tadyathāpināma sarvaśūra mṛtasya puruṣasya mātāpitarau: śocanti paridevanti na ca śaknuvanti trātum; 5. evam eva sarvaśūra bālapṛthagjanāḥ satvā na śaknuvanty ātmahitaṃ parahitaṃ vā kartuṃ, nirāśā iva mātāpitaraḥ; 6. evam eva sarvaśūra nirāśā bhavanti te satvā maraṇakālasamaye.
SaSū(C) 41
body.translated_text: 1. There are, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, two beings who are without hope. Which two? Namely, one being who commits evil <s>karma</s> (action) or causes it to be committed; the second rejects the true <s>Dharma</s>. These two beings are without hope at the time of death.

body.text: 1. dvāv imau sarvaśūra satvau nirāśau. katamau dvau? yad utaikaḥ satvaḥ pāpaṃ karma karoti kārāpayati vā. dvitīyaḥ saddharmaṃ pratikṣipati. imau dvau satvau nirāśau maraṇakālasamaye.
SaSū(C) 42
body.translated_text: 1. The <s>Bodhisattva Sarvaśūra</s> said: Venerable <s>Bhagavān</s>, what is the destination of those beings, what is their future state? The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: Endless is the destination, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, of beings who reject the true <s>Dharma</s>; endless is their future state: 3. for a <s>kalpa</s> (aeon), <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, they will experience painful sensation in the great hell <s>Raurava</s> (the Screaming); 4. for a <s>kalpa</s> in <s>Saṃghāta</s> (the Crushing); 5. for a <s>kalpa</s> in <s>Tapana</s> (the Heating); 6. for a <s>kalpa</s> in <s>Pratāpana</s> (the Great Heating); 7. for a <s>kalpa</s> in the great hell <s>Kālasūtra</s> (the Black Thread); 8. for a <s>kalpa</s> in the great hell <s>Mahāvīci</s> (the Great Without Interval); 9. for a <s>kalpa</s> in the great hell <s>Romaharṣa</s> (the Hair-raising); 10. for a <s>kalpa</s> in the great hell <s>Hahava</s> (the Wailing). 11. In these eight great hells, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, for eight <s>kalpas</s>, suffering must be experienced by beings who reject the true <s>Dharma</s>.

body.text: 1. sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: kā bhadanta bhagavaṃs teṣāṃ satvānāṃ gatiḥ, ko 'bhisaṃparāyo bhavati? bhagavān āha: anantā gatiḥ sarvaśūra saddharmapratikṣepakānāṃ satvānāṃ, ananto 'bhisaṃparāyaḥ: 3. kalpam eva te sarvaśūra raurave mahānarake duḥkhāṃ vedanāṃ vedayiṣyanti, 4. kalpaṃ saṃghāte, 5. kalpaṃ tapane, 6. kalpaṃ pratāpane, 7. kalpaṃ kālasūtre mahānarake, 8. kalpaṃ mahāvīcau mahānarake, 9. kalpaṃ romaharṣe mahānarake, 10. kalpaṃ hahave mahānarake. 11. imeṣv aṣṭasu mahānarakeṣu sarvaśūra aṣṭau kalpāḥ saddharmapratikṣepakaiḥ satvair duḥkham anubhavitavyam.
SaSū(C) 43
body.translated_text: 1. Then the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Sarvaśūra</s> spoke thus to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: Suffering, O <s>Bhagavān</s>! Suffering, O <s>Sugata</s> (Well-gone One)! I cannot bear to hear it! 2. Then at that moment, the <s>Bhagavān</s> spoke these verses:

body.text: 1. atha khalu sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhagavantam etad avocat: duḥkhaṃ bhagavan duḥkhaṃ sugata notsahāmi śrotuṃ! 2. atha khalu bhagavāṃs tasyāṃ velāyām imā gāthā abhāṣata:

children.text: (1) kim tvaṃ notsahase śrotum idaṃ vākyaṃ mahābhayam /
children.translated_text: (1) Why can you not bear to hear this word of great terror?

children.text: narakāṃ duḥkhasaṃyogā satvā vindanti vedanāṃ //
children.translated_text: Beings in the hells experience sensation through the conjunction of suffering.

children.text: (2) yat karoti śubhaṃ karma sukhaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: (2) Whatever wholesome <s>karma</s> (action) one performs, happiness shall be its result;

children.text: yat karoty aśubhaṃ karma duḥkham eva bhaviṣyati //
children.translated_text: whatever unwholesome <s>karma</s> one performs, suffering alone shall be its result.

children.text: (3) jātasya maraṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ śokaṃ duḥkho 'tha bandhanaṃ /
children.translated_text: (3) For one who is born, death is suffering; grief, suffering, and bondage too;

children.text: nityaṃ duḥkhaṃ hi bālasya sukhaheto na vetti yaḥ //
children.translated_text: suffering is constant for the fool who does not know the cause of happiness.

children.text: (4) paṇḍitānāṃ sukhaṃ yo vai smarate buddhadakṣiṇāṃ /
children.translated_text: (4) The happiness of the wise — he who remembers the offering to the <s>Buddha</s>;

children.text: prasannāś ca mahāyāne na te yāsyanti durgatim //
children.translated_text: those who are faithful to the <s>Mahāyāna</s> (Great Vehicle) shall not go to a bad destination.

children.text: (5) evam eva sarvaśūra pūrvakarmapracoditaṃ /
children.translated_text: (5) Just so, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, impelled by former <s>karma</s> (action),

children.text: alpaṃ hi kṛyate karma mahāntaṃ bhujyate phalaṃ //
children.translated_text: even a small deed performed yields a great result to be experienced.

children.text: (6) bījam alpaṃ yathā vāpya prabhūtaṃ labhate phalaṃ /
children.translated_text: (6) Just as, having sown a small seed, one obtains abundant fruit,

children.text: buddhakṣetre tu sukṣetre vījaṃ vai yatra rūhyate //
children.translated_text: so in the <s>Buddha</s>-field, in that good field, the seed indeed sprouts.

children.text: (7) paṇḍitānāṃ sukhaṃ bhavati ramante jinaśāsane /
children.translated_text: (7) There is happiness for the wise; they delight in the teaching of the <s>Jina</s> (Victorious One);

children.text: vivarjayanti pāpāni kurvanti kuśalaṃ bahu //
children.translated_text: they avoid evil deeds and perform much that is wholesome.

children.text: (8) āṇumātraṃ pradāsyanti ye dānaṃ mama śāsane /
children.translated_text: (8) Those who give even the smallest gift in my teaching,

children.text: aśītiḥ kalpasahasrāṇi mahābhogā mahādhanāḥ //
children.translated_text: for eighty thousand <s>kalpas</s> (aeons) shall be of great enjoyment and great wealth.

children.text: (9) yatra yatropapadyante nityaṃ dānaṃ smaranti te /
children.translated_text: (9) Wherever they are reborn, they always remember generosity;

children.text: evaṃ mahāphalā hy eṣā gaṃbhīrā buddhadakṣiṇā //
children.translated_text: thus this offering to the <s>Buddha</s> is of great fruit and profound.

body.text: SaSū(C) 44
body.translated_text: 1. Then the <s>Bodhisattva Mahāsattva Sarvaśūra</s> spoke thus to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: How, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, should the <s>Dharma</s> be understood in the <s>Bhagavān's</s> teaching? How, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, having heard the <s>Saṃghāṭa Sūtra</s> discourse on the <s>Dharma</s>, will the roots of merit be grasped? 2. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, one who would attend upon <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, Perfectly Awakened Ones equal in number to the sand grains of twelve <s>Gaṅgā</s> rivers with all provisions of happiness, and one who would hear this <s>Saṃghāṭa Sūtra</s> discourse on the <s>Dharma</s> — the mass of merit of the latter should be understood as equal.

body.text: 1. atha khalu sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhagavantam etad avocat: kathaṃ bhagavan bhagavataḥ śāsane dharmo jñātavyaḥ? kathaṃ bhagavan saṃghāṭaṃ sūtraṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śrutvā kuśalamūlaṃ parigṛhītaṃ bhaviṣyati? 2. bhagavān āha: yaḥ sarvaśūra dvādaśagaṃgānadībālikāsamāṃs tathāgatān arhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhān sarvasukhopadhānairupatiṣṭheta, yaś cemaṃ saṃghāṭasūtraṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śṛṇuyād evam eva tasya puṇyaskandho jñātavyaḥ.
SaSū(C) 45

1. sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: kathaṃ bhagavan kuśalamūlaparipūriḥ kartavyā evam ukte bhagavān sarvaśūraṃ bodhisatvaṃ mahāsatvam etad avocat: yat sarvaśūra kuśalamūlaṃ tat tathāgatasamaṃ jñātavyaṃ. 3. sarvaśūra āha: katamac ca bhagavan kuśalamūlaṃ tathāgatasamaṃ jñātavyaṃ? bhagavān āha: dharmabhāṇakaḥ sarvaśūra tathāgatasamo jñātavyaḥ. 5. sarvaśūra āha: katamo bhagavan dharmabhāṇakaḥ? 6. bhagavān āha: yaḥ saṃghāṭaṃ sūtraṃ śrāvayati sa dharmabhāṇakaḥ.
body.translated_text: 1. The <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'How, O Blessed One, should the fulfillment of roots of merit be accomplished?' Thus addressed, the Blessed One spoke this to the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s>: 'Whatever root of merit there is, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, that should be known as equal to the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' 3. <s>Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'And what root of merit, O Blessed One, should be known as equal to the <s>Tathāgata</s>?' The Blessed One said: 'The preacher of the <s>Dharma</s>, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, should be known as equal to the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' 5. <s>Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'Who, O Blessed One, is the preacher of the <s>Dharma</s>?' 6. The Blessed One said: 'He who causes others to hear the <s>Saṃghāṭa-sūtra</s> — he is the preacher of the <s>Dharma</s>.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 46

1. sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: ye bhagavan saṃghāṭasūtraṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śroṣyanti te īdṛśaṃ puṇyaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyanti; kaḥ punar vādo ye likhiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti; kiyantaṃ te bhagavan puṇyaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyanti? 2. bhagavān āha: śṛṇu sarvaśūra, tadyathā caturṣu dikṣv ekaikasyān diśi dvādaśagaṃgānadībālikāsamāṃs tathāgatān arhataḥ samyaksaṃbuddhāṃ dvādaśagaṃgānadībālikāsamān kalpān avatiṣṭhanto dharmaṃ deśayeyur; asya saṃghāṭasūtrasya dharmaparyāyasya puṇyaskandhaṃ varṇayeyur lekhayatas tasya puṇyaskandhasya na śakyaṃ paryantam adhigantuṃ, vācayā vā vyāhartuṃ. 3. aṣṭācatvāriṅśadbhir api gaṃgānādibālikāsamair buddhair bhagavadbhir na śakyaṃ likhyamānasya yat puṇyaskandhaṃ tad vyāhartuṃ. 4. kaḥ punar vādo ye vācayiṣyanti, cintayiṣyanti vā, ye vā dharmadhyānā bhaviṣyanti.
body.translated_text: 1. The <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'Those, O Blessed One, who will hear this <s>Dharma</s> discourse, the <s>Saṃghāṭa-sūtra</s>, will produce such a mass of merit; what need to speak of those who will write it or cause it to be recited! How great a mass of merit will they produce, O Blessed One?' 2. The Blessed One said: 'Listen, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>. Suppose that in the four directions, in each direction, <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, perfectly enlightened Buddhas, as many as the grains of sand of twelve <s>Gaṅgā</s> rivers, were to remain for <s>kalpas</s> as many as the grains of sand of twelve <s>Gaṅgā</s> rivers, teaching the <s>Dharma</s>; [even if] they were to describe the mass of merit of this <s>Saṃghāṭa-sūtra</s> <s>Dharma</s> discourse — it would not be possible to reach the limit of the mass of merit of one who writes it, nor to express it in speech. 3. Even by forty-eight [times] as many Buddhas, Blessed Ones, as the grains of sand of the <s>Gaṅgā</s> rivers, it would not be possible to express the mass of merit of one who is writing it. 4. What need to speak of those who will recite it, or contemplate it, or those who will engage in meditation on the <s>Dharma</s>!'

body.text: SaSū(C) 47
1. sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: kiyantaṃ bhagavan vācayamānāḥ puṇyaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyanti? 2. atha khalu bhagavāṃs tasyāṃ velāyām imā gāthā abhāṣatā:
body.translated_text: 1. The <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'How great a mass of merit will those who recite it produce, O Blessed One?' 2. Then at that time the Blessed One spoke these verses:

children.text: (1) catuṣpadāyāṃ gāthāyāṃ vācitāyāṃ tu yac chubhaṃ /
children.translated_text: (1) When a four-line verse has been recited, the merit that arises —

children.text: caturaśīti gaṃgāyā bālikā syuḥ samā jināḥ //
children.translated_text: even if there were <s>Jinas</s> (Buddhas) equal in number to the grains of sand of eighty-four <s>Gaṅgā</s> rivers,

children.text: (2) te vācitasyeha yat puṇyaṃ kathayeyur aviṣṭhitāḥ /
children.translated_text: (2) and they were to describe ceaselessly the merit of what has been recited here,

children.text: na ca kṣīyeta tat puṇyaṃ vāvad vyākaraṇaṃ bhavet //
children.translated_text: that merit would not be exhausted, even until the time of prophecy (<s>vyākaraṇa</s>).

children.text: (3) buddhānāṃ koṭayo 'śītis tiṣṭheyuḥ kalpatāttakān /
children.translated_text: (3) Eighty <s>koṭis</s> (tens of millions) of Buddhas might remain for <s>kalpas</s> reaching to the utmost,

children.text: mahāyānaguṇāḥ sarve varṇayeyur daśo diśaḥ //
children.translated_text: and describe all the virtues of the <s>Mahāyāna</s> in the ten directions —

children.text: (4) saṃghāṭasya ca yat puṇyaṃ tat kṣayaṃ naiva ca vrajet /
children.translated_text: (4) yet the merit of the <s>Saṃghāṭa</s> would never come to exhaustion;

children.text: buddhānān durlabhā evam anantā dharmadeśanā //
children.translated_text: thus rare indeed is the infinite <s>Dharma</s>-teaching of the Buddhas.

body.text: SaSū(C) 48

tena khalu punaḥ kālena tena samayena caturaśītir devaputrakoṭiśatasahasrāṇi, yena tathāgato, yena ca saṃghāṭasūtraṃ dharmaparyāyanirdeśaṃ, tenāṃjalayaḥ praṇamya, bhagavantam etad avocan: sādhu sādhu bhagavan yena bhagavatā īdṛśaṃ dharmanidhānaṃ jaṃbudvīpe sthāpitaṃ.
body.translated_text: Then at that time, eighty-four <s>koṭi</s>-hundred-thousands of <s>devaputras</s> (sons of gods), approaching the <s>Tathāgata</s> and the place where the <s>Saṃghāṭa-sūtra</s> <s>Dharma</s> discourse was being expounded, joining their palms in reverence, said to the Blessed One: 'Excellent, excellent, O Blessed One, that the Blessed One has established such a treasure of <s>Dharma</s> in <s>Jambudvīpa</s>!'

body.text: (49) 1. aṣṭādaśa koṭīsahasrāṇi nigranthānāṃ, yena bhagavāms tenopasaṃkrāntā, upasaṃkramya, bhagavantam evam āhuḥ: jayatu bhoḥ śramaṇo gautamaḥ! 2. bhagavān āha: tathāgato nityam eva jayati. bho nigranthatīrthikāḥ kathaṃ yuṣmākaṃ tīrthikānāṃ jayam? 3. te 'vocan: jayatv jayatv eva śramaṇo gautamaḥ! 4. bhagavān āha: nāhaṃ yuṣmākaṃ jayaṃ paśyāmi. āha ca:
body.translated_text: (49) 1. Eighteen <s>koṭi</s>-thousands of <s>Nirgranthas</s> (Jain ascetics) approached the Blessed One, and having approached, said to the Blessed One: 'Victory to the ascetic <s>Gautama</s>!' 2. The Blessed One said: 'The <s>Tathāgata</s> is always victorious. O <s>Nirgrantha</s> <s>tīrthikas</s> (non-Buddhist teachers), what is victory for you <s>tīrthikas</s>?' 3. They said: 'Victory, victory indeed to the ascetic <s>Gautama</s>!' 4. The Blessed One said: 'I do not see your victory.' And he spoke:

children.text: (1) viparītā sthitā yūyaṃ bhaviṣyati jayaḥ kathaṃ /
children.translated_text: (1) You stand in a perverted way — how will there be victory?

children.text: yūyaṃ śṛṇutha nigranthā vakṣyāmi bhavatāṃ hitaṃ //
children.translated_text: Listen, O <s>Nirgranthas</s>! I shall speak what is beneficial for you.

children.text: (2) bālabuddheḥ sukhaṃ nāsti kiṃ jayaṃ vo bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: (2) For one of childish intelligence there is no happiness — what victory will there be for you?

children.text: mārgaṃ tu te na jānaṃti ko jayaṃ te bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: They do not know the path — what victory will there be for them?

children.text: ahaṃ mārgaṃ tu darśemi gaṃbhīraṃ buddhacakṣuṣā //
children.translated_text: I show the path, the profound one, with the eye of a Buddha.

body.text: SaSū(C) 50
1. atha te nigranthā bhagavato 'ntike kruddhā aprasādacittam utpādayām āsuḥ. 2. tena khalu punaḥ kālena tena samayena śakro devānām indro vajraṃ parāhanat.
body.translated_text: 1. Then those <s>Nirgranthas</s>, enraged in the presence of the Blessed One, generated minds of displeasure. 2. Then at that time, <s>Śakra</s>, lord of the gods, struck his thunderbolt (<s>vajra</s>).

body.text: SaSū(C) 51

1. atha te 'ṣṭādaśa koṭyo nigranthānāṃ, bhītās, trastā, mahātā duḥkhadaurmanasyenārtā aśrukaṇṭhā rudanti. 2. tathāgataś ca svakam ātmānam antardhitaṃ darśayati sma. 3. atha te nigranthā asrumukhā rudanti, tathāgatam apaśyantaś ca gāthāṃ babhāṣire:
body.translated_text: 1. Then those eighteen <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Nirgranthas</s>, frightened, terrified, afflicted with great suffering and mental anguish, wept with tears in their throats. 2. And the <s>Tathāgata</s> caused his own person to become invisible. 3. Then those <s>Nirgranthas</s>, with tear-stained faces, weeping, not seeing the <s>Tathāgata</s>, spoke this verse:

children.text: (1) nāsti kaścid iha trāṇāṃ na mātā na pitā tathā /
children.translated_text: (1) There is no protection here, neither mother nor father;

children.text: atavīm iha paśyāma śūnyāgārāṃ nirālayāṃ //
children.translated_text: we see a wilderness here, an empty abode, without shelter.

children.text: (2) udakaṃ caiva naivāsti na vṛkṣā na ca pakṣīṇāḥ /
children.translated_text: (2) There is no water either, no trees, no birds;

children.text: janaṃ cātra na paśyāma anāthā duḥkhavedanāṃ //
children.translated_text: we see no people here — helpless, we feel suffering!

body.text: (3) vedayāmo mahāghorām apaśyantas tathāgatam /
body.translated_text: (3) We feel a great dread, not seeing the <s>Tathāgata</s>!

body.text: SaSū(C) 52
1. tena khalu punaḥ kālena tena samayena te 'ṣṭādaśa koṭyo nigranthānām utthāyāyanebhyo, jānudvayaṃ bhūmau nipātya, śabdam udīrayanti, ghoṣam anuśrāvayanti:
body.translated_text: 1. Then at that time, those eighteen <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Nirgranthas</s> rose from their seats, placed both knees on the ground, and raised their voices, making this proclamation:

children.text: (1) tathāgata trāṇaṃ bhavāhi saṃbuddho dbipadottamaḥ /
children.translated_text: (1) O <s>Tathāgata</s>, be our protector! O perfectly awakened one, supreme among the two-footed!

children.text: kuruṣva hitam asmākaṃ trāyasva kṛpaṇaṃ jagat //
children.translated_text: Act for our benefit! Save this pitiable world!

body.text: SaSū(C) 53

1. atha bhagavān smitaṃ prāduṣkṛtvā sarvaśūraṃ bodhisatvaṃ mahāsatvam āmantrayati: gaccha sarvaśūra, nigranthānām anyatīrthikānān dharman deśaya. 2. evam ukte sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhagavantam etad avocat: nanu bhagavan kālaparvatāḥ sumeroḥ parvatarājasya śirasā praṇamanti? tiṣṭhati tathāgate, 'haṃ dharman deśayāmi? 3. bhagavān āha: alaṃ kulaputra, bahu tathāgatānām upāyakauśalyaṃ. 4. gaccha sarvaśūra, vyavalokaya daśa diśa, lokadhātūn paśya, kva tathāgataṃ paśyasi, kutra vā tathāgatasyāsanaṃ prajñaptaṃ paśyasi. 5. aham eva sarvaśūra nigranthānāṃ anyatīrthikānāṃ dharman deśayiṣyāmi.
body.translated_text: 1. Then the Blessed One, having displayed a smile, addressed the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s>: 'Go, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, teach the <s>Dharma</s> to the <s>Nirgranthas</s> and other <s>tīrthikas</s>.' 2. Thus addressed, the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s> said to the Blessed One: 'But surely, O Blessed One, the dark mountains bow their heads before <s>Sumeru</s>, king of mountains? While the <s>Tathāgata</s> remains, shall I teach the <s>Dharma</s>?' 3. The Blessed One said: 'Enough, son of good family! Great is the skill in means of the <s>Tathāgatas</s>. 4. Go, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, survey the ten directions, behold the world-realms, see where you see the <s>Tathāgata</s>, or where you see a seat prepared for the <s>Tathāgata</s>. 5. I myself, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, shall teach the <s>Dharma</s> to the <s>Nirgranthas</s> and other <s>tīrthikas</s>.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 54

1. sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: kasya bhadanta bhagavan ṛddhyānubhāvena gacchāmi? svaṛddher vā, atha vā tathāgatasya rddhyānubhāvena gacchāmi? 2. bhagavān āha: svakena sarvaśūra ṛddhibalādhiṣṭhānena gaccha, punar eva sarvaśūra tathāgatasya rddhyanubhāvenāgacchaḥ. 3. atha khalu sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatva utthāyāsanād, bhagavantaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya, tatraivāntardhitaḥ.
body.translated_text: 1. The <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'By whose supernatural power (<s>ṛddhi</s>), Venerable Blessed One, shall I go? By my own <s>ṛddhi</s>, or by the supernatural power of the <s>Tathāgata</s>?' 2. The Blessed One said: 'Go, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, by your own <s>ṛddhi</s>-power and empowerment; but come back, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, by the supernatural power of the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' 3. Then the <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s> rose from his seat, circumambulated the Blessed One, and vanished right there.

body.text: SaSū(C) 55

1. atha khalu bhagavāṃs teṣām anyatīrthikānāṃ dharman deśayati: 2. jātir mārṣā duḥkhaṃ, jātir eva duḥkhaṃ, jātasya sato bahūni bhayāny utpadyante: jātasya vyādhibhayāny utpadyante, vyādhitasya jarābhayāny utpadyante, jīrṇasya mṛtyubhayany utpadyante. 3. ta āhuḥ: katamad bhagavāñ jātasya bhayaṃ?
body.translated_text: 1. Then the Blessed One taught the <s>Dharma</s> to those <s>tīrthikas</s>: 2. 'Birth, sirs, is suffering; birth itself is suffering. For one who is born, many fears arise: for one who is born, fears of disease arise; for one who is diseased, fears of old age arise; for one who is aged, fears of death arise.' 3. They said: 'What, O Blessed One, is the fear of one who is born?'

body.text: SaSū(C) 56

1. bhagavān āha: jātaṃ jātam iti nāma! 2. jātasya puruṣasya bahūni bhayāni jāyante, 3. tadyathā: rājabhayaṃ jāyate, 4. corabhayaṃ jāyate, 5. agnibhayaṃ jāyate, 6. viṣabhayaṃ jāyate, 7. udakabhayaṃ jāyate, 8. vāyubhayaṃ jāyate, 9. āvartabhayaṃ jāyate, 10. svakṛtānāṃ karmaṇāṃ bhayaṃ jāyate.
body.translated_text: 1. The Blessed One said: 'Born, born — that is the name! 2. For a person who is born, many fears arise, 3. namely: fear of kings arises, 4. fear of thieves arises, 5. fear of fire arises, 6. fear of poison arises, 7. fear of water arises, 8. fear of wind arises, 9. fear of whirlpools arises, 10. fear of one's own past deeds (<s>karma</s>) arises.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 57
evaṃ tena kālena tena samayena teṣām anyatīrthikānāṃ nigranthānāṃ mahāsantrāso 'bhavad, evaṃ cāhuḥ: na bhūyo vayaṃ bhagavann utsahāmahe jatiduḥkham anubhavitum!
body.translated_text: Thus at that time there arose great terror among those <s>Nirgrantha</s> <s>tīrthikas</s>, and they said: 'Never again, O Blessed One, do we dare to experience the suffering of birth!'

body.text: SaSū(C) 58
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 58

body.text: 1. asmin khalu punaḥ saṃghāṭe dharmaparyāye bhagavatā bhāṣyamāṇe, te 'ṣṭādaśa koṭyo nigranthā anyatīrthikāḥ pariniṣpannā abhūvann anuttarasyāḥ samyaksaṃbodheḥ; 2. svakāye cāṣṭādaśa bodhisatvasahasrāḥ daśabhūmipratiṣṭhitāḥ, sarve nānārddhivikurvitāni sandarśayām āsuḥ; 3. tadyathā: aśvarūpaṃ, hastirūpaṃ, siṃharūpaṃ, vyāghrarūpaṃ, garuḍarūpaṃ, sumerurūpaṃ, nandikarūpaṃ, kecid vṛkṣarūpaṃ. 4. te sarve padmāsane paryaṃkena niṣīdanti. 5. nava koṭīsahasrāṇi bodhisatvānāṃ bhagavato dakṣiṇe pārśve niṣīdanti. nava koṭīsahasrāṇi bodhisatvānāṃ bhagavato vāme pārśve niṣīdanti. 6. tathāgatas tu nityaṃ samāhitaḥ upāyakauśalyena satvānāṃ dharman deśayan saṃdṛśyate.
body.translated_text: 1. Now, when this <s>Saṃghāṭa</s> discourse on the <s>Dharma</s> was being spoken by the <s>Bhagavān</s> (Blessed One), those eighteen <s>koṭis</s> (tens of millions) of <s>Nirgrantha</s> (Jain) and other non-Buddhist ascetics attained realization of unsurpassed perfect awakening (<s>anuttarā samyaksaṃbodhi</s>); 2. and in his own assembly, eighteen thousand <s>bodhisattvas</s> became established on the ten stages (<s>daśabhūmi</s>), and all displayed various miraculous transformations (<s>ṛddhi-vikurvita</s>); 3. namely: the form of a horse, the form of an elephant, the form of a lion, the form of a tiger, the form of a <s>Garuḍa</s>, the form of <s>Sumeru</s>, the form of <s>Nandika</s>, and some the form of a tree. 4. All of them sat cross-legged on lotus seats. 5. Nine thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>bodhisattvas</s> sat at the <s>Bhagavān</s>'s right side. Nine thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>bodhisattvas</s> sat at the <s>Bhagavān</s>'s left side. 6. The <s>Tathāgata</s>, however, always in <s>samādhi</s> (concentration), was seen teaching the <s>Dharma</s> to beings through skillful means (<s>upāyakauśalya</s>).

body.text: SaSū(C) 59
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 59

body.text: 1. yāvat saptame rātṛdivase tathāgataḥ pāṇitalaṃ prasārayati, jānāti ca bhagavān: sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatvas tasyāḥ padmottarāyā lokadhātor ihāgacchatīti; 2. yadā ca sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatvo gatas, tadā sapta rātrindivasais tāṃ padmottarāṃ lokadhātum anuprāptaḥ, svaṛddhibalādhiṣṭhānena, 3. yadā ca bhagavān bahuṃ prasārayati, tadā sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhagavataḥ purataḥ sthitaḥ. 4. bhagavantaṃ saptakṛt pradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhagavato 'ntike cittaṃ prasādayamāno, yena tathāgatas tenāṃjaliṃ praṇāmya, bhagavantam etad avocat:
body.translated_text: 1. On the seventh day and night, the <s>Tathāgata</s> extended his palm, and the <s>Bhagavān</s> knew: 'The <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s> (All-Heroic) is coming here from that <s>Padmottarā</s> (Supreme Lotus) world-system.' 2. When the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s> had departed, he reached that <s>Padmottarā</s> world-system in seven days and nights, by the power of his own miraculous abilities (<s>ṛddhi-bala</s>). 3. When the <s>Bhagavān</s> extended [his hand] far, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Sarvaśūra</s> stood before the <s>Bhagavān</s>. 4. Having circumambulated the <s>Bhagavān</s> seven times, generating faith in his mind in the <s>Bhagavān</s>'s presence, joining his palms toward the <s>Tathāgata</s> and bowing, he said to the <s>Bhagavān</s>:

body.text: SaSū(C) 60
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 60

body.text: gato 'smi bhagavan daśasu dikṣu sarvalokadhātuṣu. 2. dṛṣṭāni me bhagavan navānavati koṭīsahasrāṇi buddhakṣetrāṇām ekayā ṛddhyā; dvitīyayā ṛddhyā buddhānāṃ bhagavatāṃ koṭīśatasahasraṃ.
body.translated_text: 'I have gone, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, to all the world-systems in the ten directions. 2. I have seen, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, ninety-nine thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Buddha</s>-fields with one miraculous power; and with a second miraculous power, a hundred thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bhagavāns</s>.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 61
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 61

body.text: yāvat saptame rātṛdivase tāṃ padmottarāṃ lokadhātum anuprāptaḥ, 2. atrāntaraṃ akṣobhyakoṭīsahasraṃ buddhakṣetrāṇāṃ dṛṣṭaṃ, tato 'haṃ teṣāṃ buddhānāṃ bhagavatām ṛddhiṃ paśyāmi. dvānavatiṣu buddhakṣetrakoṭīśatasahasreṣu tathāgatā dharman deśayanti. 4. aśītiṣu koṭīśatasahasreṣu buddhakṣetreṣu tatraiva divase aśīti koṭīśatasahasrāṇi tathāgatānām arhatāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāṃ loka utpannāni. 5. sarvāṃś ca tān ahaṃ tathāgatān vanditvā punar eva prakrāntaḥ.
body.translated_text: 'On the seventh day and night I reached that <s>Padmottarā</s> world-system. 2. In the meantime, I saw a thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Akṣobhya</s> <s>Buddha</s>-fields, and then I beheld the miraculous powers of those <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bhagavāns</s>. In ninety-two hundred thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Buddha</s>-fields, <s>Tathāgatas</s> are teaching the <s>Dharma</s>. 4. In eighty hundred thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Buddha</s>-fields, on that very day, eighty hundred thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, fully-awakened <s>Buddhas</s> appeared in the world. 5. Having paid homage to all those <s>Tathāgatas</s>, I departed again.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 62
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 62

body.text: 1. tatraiva divase bhagavann ekonacatvāriṃśad buddhakṣetrakoṭīsahasrāṇy atikramya, sarveṣu ca teṣv ekūnacatvāriṃśatsu buddhakṣetrakoṭīsahasreṣv ekūnacatvāriṃśat koṭīsahasrāṇi bodhisatvānāṃ niṣkramya, tatraiva divase 'nuttarāṃ samyaksaṃbodhim abhisaṃbuddhāḥ. 2. vanditāś ca me bhagavan te tathāgatā arhantaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhās; tṛguptaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya, ṛddhyā cāntardhitaḥ.
body.translated_text: 1. 'On that very day, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, having traversed thirty-nine thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Buddha</s>-fields, in all those thirty-nine thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Buddha</s>-fields, thirty-nine thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>bodhisattvas</s> went forth and on that very day attained unsurpassed perfect awakening (<s>anuttarā samyaksaṃbodhi</s>). 2. I paid homage, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, to those <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, fully-awakened <s>Buddhas</s>; having circumambulated them with threefold restraint, I vanished by miraculous power.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 63
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 63

body.text: 1. ṣaṣṭikoṭiṣu bhagavan buddhakṣetreṣu buddhān bhagavataḥ paśyāmi. 2. vanditāni ca me bhagavan tāni buddhakṣetrāṇi, te ca buddhā bhagavantas; tataś cāhaṃ prakrāntaṃ.
body.translated_text: 1. 'In sixty <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Buddha</s>-fields, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, I see <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bhagavāns</s>. 2. I paid homage, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, to those <s>Buddha</s>-fields and those <s>Buddhas</s> and <s>Bhagavāns</s>; and then I departed.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 64
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 64

body.text: śatakoṭīṣu bhagavaṃ buddhakṣetreṣu tathāgatān parinirvāyamāṇān paśyāmi. 2. vanditāś ca me te tathāgatās; tataś cāhaṃ prakrāntaḥ.
body.translated_text: 'In a hundred <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Buddha</s>-fields, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, I see <s>Tathāgatas</s> entering <s>Parinirvāṇa</s> (final passing). 2. I paid homage to those <s>Tathāgatas</s>; and then I departed.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 65
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 65

body.text: 1. dṛṣṭaṃ ca me bhagavann apareṣu paṃcanavatikoṭiṣu buddhakṣetreṣu saddharmam antardhāyantaṃ. 2. cintāyāso me bhagavaṃs tatra jātaḥ, 3. asrūṇi ca pramuṃcāmi, anyāṃś ca rodamānān bahūn devanāgayakṣarākṣasān kāmarūpinaś ca mahatā śokaśalyena samarpitān paśyāmi; 4. evam aparaṃ buddhakṣetraṃ niravaśeṣaṃ dagdhaṃ sasamudraṃ sasumeruṃ sapṛthivīpradeśaṃ, tam api bhagavan vanditvā, nirāśībhūtaḥ.
body.translated_text: 1. 'I also saw, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, in another ninety-five <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Buddha</s>-fields the true <s>Dharma</s> disappearing. 2. Grief and distress arose in me there, O <s>Bhagavān</s>. 3. I shed tears, and I saw many others weeping — <s>devas</s> (gods), <s>nāgas</s> (serpents), <s>yakṣas</s>, <s>rākṣasas</s> (demons), and shape-shifters, all afflicted by the great thorn of sorrow. 4. Furthermore, I saw a <s>Buddha</s>-field completely burned — together with its ocean, its <s>Sumeru</s>, and its expanse of earth; having paid homage even to that, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, I became free from hope.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 66
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 66

body.text: 1. prakrānto 'smi yāvad ahaṃ bhagavan tāṃ padmottarāṃ lokadhātum anuprāptaḥ. 2. tasyāṃ ca bhagavan padmottarāyāṃ lokadhātau paṃca koṭīśatasahasrāṇy āsanānāṃ prajñaptān paśyāmi: 3. dakṣiṇasyān diśi koṭīśatasahasram āsanānāṃ prajñaptān paśyāmi; 4. vāmena pārśvena koṭīśatasahasram āsanānāṃ prajñaptān paśyāmi; 5. pūrvasyān diśi koṭīśatasahasram āsanānāṃ prajñaptān paśyāmi; paścimāyān diśi koṭīśatasahasram āsanānāṃ prajñaptān paśyāmi; 7. ūrdhvāyāṃ diśi koṭīśatasahasram āsanānāṃ prajñaptān paśyāmi.
body.translated_text: 1. 'I departed, and eventually, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, I reached that <s>Padmottarā</s> world-system. 2. In that <s>Padmottarā</s> world-system, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, I see five hundred thousand <s>koṭis</s> of seats arranged: 3. in the southern direction I see a hundred thousand <s>koṭis</s> of seats arranged; 4. on the left side I see a hundred thousand <s>koṭis</s> of seats arranged; 5. in the eastern direction I see a hundred thousand <s>koṭis</s> of seats arranged; in the western direction I see a hundred thousand <s>koṭis</s> of seats arranged; 7. in the upper direction I see a hundred thousand <s>koṭis</s> of seats arranged.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 67
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 67

body.text: 1. sarvāṇi ca bhagavan tāny āsanāni saptaratnamayāni; 2. sarveṣu ca teṣv āsaneṣu tathāgatā arhantaḥ samyaksaṃbuddhā niṣaṇṇā dharman deśayanti. 3. tatrāhaṃ bhagavann, āścaryaprāptas, tāṃs tathāgatān paripṛcchāmi: kin nāmeyaṃ bhagavanto lokadhātuḥ? 5. te tathāgatā āhuḥ: padmottarā nāmeyaṃ kulaputra lokadhātuḥ.
body.translated_text: 1. 'All those seats, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, were made of the seven precious substances (<s>saptaratna</s>). 2. On all those seats, <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, fully-awakened <s>Buddhas</s> were seated, teaching the <s>Dharma</s>. 3. There, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, filled with wonder, I asked those <s>Tathāgatas</s>: "What is the name of this world-system, O <s>Bhagavāns</s>?" 5. Those <s>Tathāgatas</s> said: "This world-system, O son of good family, is called <s>Padmottarā</s> (Supreme Lotus)."'

body.text: SaSū(C) 68
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 68

body.text: 1. tato 'haṃ bhagavaṃs, tān pradakṣiṇīkṛtya, punar api tāṃs tathāgatān paripṛcchāmi: 2. kin nāma iha buddhakṣetre tathāgataḥ? 3. te tathāgatā āhuḥ: padmagarbho nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddho ya iha buddhakṣetre buddhakṛtyaṃ karoti. 4. tatas tān aham etad avocat: bahūni buddhakoṭīśatasahasrāṇi dṛśyante. tan na jānāmi: katama sa padmagarbho nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddha iti. 5. bhagavān āha: ahaṃ te kulaputra darśayiṣyāmi: katamaḥ sa padmagarbho nāma tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhaḥ.
body.translated_text: 1. 'Then, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, having circumambulated them, I again asked those <s>Tathāgatas</s>: 2. "What is the name of the <s>Tathāgata</s> in this <s>Buddha</s>-field?" 3. Those <s>Tathāgatas</s> said: "The <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, fully-awakened <s>Buddha</s> named <s>Padmagarbha</s> (Lotus-Womb) is the one who performs the work of a <s>Buddha</s> in this <s>Buddha</s>-field." 4. Then I said to them: "Many hundred thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Buddhas</s> are seen. I do not know which one is the <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, fully-awakened <s>Buddha</s> named <s>Padmagarbha</s>." 5. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: "I shall show you, O son of good family, which one is the <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, fully-awakened <s>Buddha</s> named <s>Padmagarbha</s>."'

body.text: SaSū(C) 69
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 69

body.text: 1. atha tatkṣaṇād eva te sarve tathāgatakāyā antardhitāḥ, sarve ca bodhisatvarūpāṇi sandṛśyante. 2. ekam eva tathāgataṃ paśyāmi. 3. yathāhaṃ tasya tathāgatasya pādau śirasābhivandya purataḥ sthitaḥ, āsanaṃ ca prādurbhūtaṃ. sa ca māṃ tathāgata evam āha: niṣīda kulaputrātra āsane.
body.translated_text: 1. 'Then, at that very instant, all those <s>Tathāgata</s>-bodies vanished, and all appeared in the forms of <s>bodhisattvas</s>. 2. I saw only one <s>Tathāgata</s>. 3. Then I bowed at the feet of that <s>Tathāgata</s> with my head and stood before him, and a seat appeared. That <s>Tathāgata</s> said to me: "Sit down here on this seat, O son of good family."'

body.text: SaSū(C) 70
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 70

body.text: 1. athāhaṃ tasminn āsane niṣaṇṇaḥ. 2. tadā ca bhagavann anekāny āsanāni prādurbhūtāni, na ca kaścit teṣv āsaneṣu niṣaṇṇaṃ paśyāmi. 3. tad ahaṃ tathāgataṃ paripṛcchāmi: na bhagava eṣv āsaneṣu ekaṃ api satvaṃ niṣaṇṇaṃ paśyāmi. 4. sa bhagavān mām evam āha: nākṛtakuśalamūlāḥ kulaputra satvā eṣv āsaneṣu śaknuvanti niṣattum. 5. tad ahaṃ taṃ tathāgatam idam avocam: kīdṛśaṃ bhagavan satvāḥ kuśalamūlaṃ kṛtvā eṣv āsaneṣu niṣīdanti? 6. sa māṃ bhagavann evam āha: śṛṇu kulaputra, ye satvāḥ saṃghāṭaṃ sūtraṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śroṣyanti, te tena kuśalamūlena eṣv āsaneṣu niṣatsyante. kaḥ punar vādo ye likhiṣyanti vācayiṣyanti. 7. tvayā sarvaśūra saṃghāṭaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śrutaṃ yas tvam atrāsane niṣīdita. anyatra kas taveha buddhakṣetre 'bhyantarapraveśaṃ dadyāt?
body.translated_text: 1. 'Then I sat on that seat. 2. At that time, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, many seats appeared, but I did not see anyone sitting on those seats. 3. I then asked the <s>Tathāgata</s>: "O <s>Bhagavān</s>, I do not see even a single being sitting on these seats." 4. That <s>Bhagavān</s> said to me: "Beings who have not produced roots of merit (<s>kuśalamūla</s>), O son of good family, are not able to sit on these seats." 5. Then I said to that <s>Tathāgata</s>: "What kind of root of merit, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, must beings produce in order to sit on these seats?" 6. That <s>Bhagavān</s> said to me: "Listen, O son of good family — those beings who will hear the <s>Saṃghāṭa Sūtra</s>, this discourse on the <s>Dharma</s>, will sit on these seats by that root of merit. What need is there to speak of those who will write it out or recite it? 7. O <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, you have heard the <s>Saṃghāṭa</s> discourse on the <s>Dharma</s>, and therefore you sit on this seat. Who else would grant entry into this <s>Buddha</s>-field?"'

body.text: SaSū(C) 71
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 71

body.text: 1. evam ukte tena bhagavatā ahaṃ taṃ bhagavantam etad avocat: kiyantaṃ bhagavan sa satvaḥ puṇyaskandhaṃ prasaviṣyati ya imaṃ saṃghāṭaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ śroṣyati? 2. atha sa bhagavāṃ padmagarbhas tathāgato 'rhan samyaksaṃbuddhas tasyāṃ velāyāṃ smitaṃ praduṣkārṣīt. 3. tad ahaṃ bhagavan smitakāraṇaṃ taṃ bhagavantaṃ paripṛṣṭavān: ko bhagavan hetuḥ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ yat tathāgataḥ smitaṃ prāduṣkaroti?
body.translated_text: 1. 'Having been spoken to thus by that <s>Bhagavān</s>, I said to that <s>Bhagavān</s>: "How great a mass of merit, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, will a being generate who hears this <s>Saṃghāṭa</s> discourse on the <s>Dharma</s>?" 2. Then that <s>Bhagavān</s> <s>Padmagarbha</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, <s>Arhat</s>, fully-awakened <s>Buddha</s>, at that moment produced a smile. 3. I then, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, asked that <s>Bhagavān</s> the reason for the smile: "What is the cause, what is the reason, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, that the <s>Tathāgata</s> produces a smile?"'

body.text: SaSū(C) 72
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 72

body.text: 1. sa bhagavān āha: śṛṇu kulaputra sarvaśūra, bodhisatva mahāsatva, mahāsthāmaprāpta. 2. tadyathāpināma kulaputra kaścid eva rājā bhavec, cakravarttī caturdvīpeśvaraḥ, sa caturṣu dvīpakṣetreṣu tilaṃ vāpayet; 3. sarvaśūra āha: bahūni bhagavan bahūni sugata!
body.translated_text: (1) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Listen, son of good family <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s>, <s>Mahāsthāmaprāpta</s>. (2) Suppose, son of good family, there were a king, a <s>Cakravartin</s> (universal monarch), lord of the four continents, and he were to sow sesame in the fields of the four continents. (3) <s>Sarvaśūra</s> said: "Many indeed, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, many indeed, O <s>Sugata</s>!"'

body.text: SaSū(C) 73
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 73

body.text: 1. sa bhagavān āha: tataḥ sarvaśūra kaścit satvo bhaved yas tāni tilaphalakāny ekarāśiṃ kuryād, anyatarāḥ puruṣas tilaphalarāśer ekaikaṃ tilaphalakaṃ gṛhya dvitīye pārśve sthāpayet; tat kiṃ manyase sarvaśūra, śaknuyāt sa satvas tāni tilaphalakāni gaṇayituṃ vopamāṃ kartum? 2. sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: no hīdaṃ bhagavan, no hīdaṃ sugata! na śakyaṃ tāni tilaphalakāni gaṇayituṃ.
body.translated_text: (1) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Then, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, suppose a certain being were to gather all those sesame pods into one heap, and another person were to take one sesame pod at a time from the heap and place it on the other side — what do you think, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, would that being be able to count those sesame pods or make a comparison?' (2) The <s>bodhisattva Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'No indeed, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, no indeed, O <s>Sugata</s>! It is not possible to count those sesame pods.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 74
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 74

body.text: 1. bhagavān āha: evam eva sarvaśūrāsya saṃghāṭasūtrasya dharmaparyāyasya yat puṇyaskandhaṃ tan na śakyam anupamyaṃ kartum, anyatra tathāgatena. 2. tadyathā: yāvantas te tilaphalakās tāvāntas tathāgatā bhaveyuḥ; te sarve 'sya saṃghāṭasya dharmaparyāyasyanāmaṃparikīrteyeyuḥ, śravaṇakuśalamūlapuṇyaṃ ca parikīrtayeyur; na śakyam upamāṃ kartum. 3. kaḥ punar vādo yo likhiṣyati vācayiṣyati.
body.translated_text: (1) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Just so, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, the heap of merit of this <s>Saṃghāṭa Sūtra</s>, this <s>dharmaparyāya</s> (discourse), is beyond comparison, except by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. (2) Suppose that as many as those sesame pods, so many <s>Tathāgatas</s> there would be — they would all proclaim the name of this <s>Saṃghāṭa dharmaparyāya</s> and proclaim the merit of the wholesome root of hearing it — yet a comparison could not be made. (3) What then need be said of one who will copy or recite it!'

body.text: SaSū(C) 75
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 75

body.text: 1. sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: kiyantaṃ bhagavan likhataḥ puṇyaṃ bhavati ya iman dharmaparyāyaṃ likhayati? 2. bhagavān āha: śṛṇu kulaputra, tadyathāpināma kulaputra kaścid eva puruṣo bhaved yas trisāhasramahāsāhasryāṃ lokadhātau tṛṇaṃ vā, taṃ sarvaṃ aṃgulimātraṃ cchindyāt.
body.translated_text: (1) The <s>bodhisattva Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'How much merit, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, is there for one who writes, who has this <s>dharmaparyāya</s> copied?' (2) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Listen, son of good family. Suppose, son of good family, a certain man were to cut into finger-length pieces all the grass in the great trichiliocosm (<s>trisāhasramahāsāhasrī lokadhātu</s>).'

body.text: SaSū(C) 76
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 76

body.text: 1. dvitīyām upamāṃ śṛṇu sarvaśūra: 2. tadyathāpināma yāvantas trisāhasramahāsāhasryāṃ lokadhātau śilān vā, prapātān, mṛttikān vā, paramāṇurajo vā, te sarve rājānaś cakravartino bhaveyuś, caturdvīpeśvarāḥ, saptaratnasamanvāgatāḥ; tat kiṃ manyase sarvaśūra, yas teṣāṃ tāvatāṃ rājñāṃ cakravartināṃ puṇyaskandho na śakyaṃ tasyopamāṃ kartuṃ sarvasatvair api? 3. sarvaśūro bodhisatva āha: na śakyaṃ bhagavann, anyatra tathāgatāt.
body.translated_text: (1) 'Hear a second analogy, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>: (2) Suppose that as many as the stones, cliffs, clods of earth, and atoms of dust in the great trichiliocosm — all of those were to become <s>Cakravartin</s> kings, lords of the four continents, endowed with the seven treasures. What do you think, <s>Sarvaśūra</s> — could all beings make a comparison to the heap of merit of that many <s>Cakravartin</s> kings?' (3) The <s>bodhisattva Sarvaśūra</s> said: 'It is not possible, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, except by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 77
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 77

body.text: 1. bhagavān āha: evam eva sarvaśūra na śakyaṃ saṃghāṭasūtrasya dharmaparyāyasya likhyamānasya puṇyaskandhopamāṃ kartum. 2. yāvantaṃ teṣāṃ rājñāṃ cakravartināṃ puṇyam, ato bahutaraṃ puṇyaṃ prasavati ya ito dharmaparyāyād ekākṣaram api likhitvā sthāpayed; bahutaraṃ tasya puṇyaṃ vadāmi, na tv eva teṣāṃ rājñāṃ cakravartināṃ.
body.translated_text: (1) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Just so, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, it is not possible to make a comparison to the heap of merit of one who copies the <s>Saṃghāṭa Sūtra dharmaparyāya</s>. (2) However much the merit of those <s>Cakravartin</s> kings — far greater merit is produced by one who, from this <s>dharmaparyāya</s>, copies even a single syllable and preserves it. Greater is his merit, I declare, than that of those <s>Cakravartin</s> kings.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 78
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 78

body.text: 1. evam eva sarvaśūra, bodhisatvasya mahāsatvasya mahāyānasaddharmadhārakasya pratipattisthitasya, yat puṇyaṃ tan na śakyaṃ rājabhiś cakravartibhir abhibhavituṃ. 2. evam evāsya saṃghāṭasya dharmaparyāyasya lekhanād, yat puṇyaṃ, tan na śakyam upamāṃ kartuṃ. 3. imaṃ sarvaśūra saṃghāṭaṃ sūtraṃ puṇyanidhānāni darśayati; 4. sarvakleśān upaśamayati; 5. sarvadharmolkāṃ jvālayati; 6. sarvamārān pāpīmataḥ parājayati; 7. sarvabodhisatvabhavanāny ujvālayati; 8. sarvadharmanirhārān abhinirharati.
body.translated_text: (1) 'Just so, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, the merit of a <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> who upholds the true <s>Dharma</s> of the <s>Mahāyāna</s> and abides in practice — that merit cannot be surpassed by <s>Cakravartin</s> kings. (2) Just so, the merit from copying this <s>Saṃghāṭa dharmaparyāya</s> — no comparison can be made. (3) This <s>Saṃghāṭa Sūtra</s>, <s>Sarvaśūra</s>, reveals treasuries of merit; (4) it pacifies all <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions); (5) it ignites the torch of all <s>dharmas</s>; (6) it defeats all <s>Māras</s>, the Evil Ones; (7) it illuminates all the realms of <s>bodhisattvas</s>; (8) it brings forth the accomplishment of all <s>dharmas</s>...'

body.text: SaSū(C) 79
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 79

body.text: 1. evam ukte sarvaśūro bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhagavantam etad avocat: iha bhagavan brahmacaryaṃ paramaduṣkaracaryā. 2. tat kasya hetoḥ? durlabhā bhagavaṃs tathāgatacaryā, evam eva durlabhā brahmacaryā. 3. yadā ca brahmacaryaṃ cariṣyati tadā tathāgataṃ saṃmukhaṃ drakṣyati, rātṛndivaṃ ca tathāgatadarśanaṃ bhaviṣyati; 4. yadā ca tathāgataṃ paśyati tadā buddhakṣetraṃ paśyati; 5. yadā buddhakṣetraṃ paśyati tadā sarvadharmanidhānāni paśyati; 6. yadā sarvadharmanidhānāni paśyati tadāsya maraṇakālasamaye trāsaṃ notpadyate; 7. na sa jātu mātuḥ kukṣāv upapatsyate; 8. na tasya jātu śoko bhaviṣyati; 9. na ca tṛṣṇāpāśena baddho bhaviṣyati.
