They displayed great miraculous transformations (<s>ṛddhi-vikurvita</s>). 8. And seated cross-legged upon mountains, they sat down. 9. They ascended upward twenty thousand <s>yojanas</s>. 10. They descended among ten thousand <s>koṭis</s> of suns and moons.

body.text: SaSū(C) 249
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 249

body.text: atha khalu te daharāḥ satvā bhagavantam etad avocan: ko bhagavan hetuḥ kaḥ pratyayo mahāraśmyavabhāsasya, mahatāṃ ca ṛddhivikurvitānāṃ loke prādurbhūtānām? 2.bhagavān āha: paśyatha kulaputrā etau candrasūryau prādurbhūtau? 3. ta āhuḥ: paśyāmo bhadanta bhagavan, paśyāmo bhadanta sugata. 4. bhagavān āha: eṣa bodhisatvaiḥ svakāyād raśmyavabhāsa ṛddhiprātihāryaṃ ca darśitaṃ; 5. sandarśayitvā satvānān dharman deśayanti, bahujanahitāya, bahujanasukhāya, lokānukampāyair mahato janakāyasyārthāya hitāya sukhāya devānāṃ ca, manuṣyāṇāṃ ca. 6. ihaiva te mānuṣyake kāye vīryabalam upadarśayitvā īdṛśam ṛddhibalam upadarśayanti. 7. āha: deśayatu bhagavān raśmyavabhāsaprādurbhāvāya dharmam.
body.translated_text: 1. Then those young beings said to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'What, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, is the cause, what the condition, for this great radiance (<s>raśmyavabhāsa</s>) and the appearance in the world of these great miraculous displays of supernatural power (<s>ṛddhi-vikurvita</s>)?' 2. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Do you see, sons of good family, these two — sun and moon — that have appeared?' 3. They said: 'We see, Venerable <s>Bhagavān</s>! We see, Venerable <s>Sugata</s>!' 4. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'This radiance and miraculous display of supernatural power have been manifested by the <s>bodhisattvas</s> from their own bodies; 5. and having manifested them, they teach the <s>Dharma</s> to beings — for the benefit of many, for the happiness of many, out of compassion for the world, for the welfare, benefit, and happiness of a great multitude of people, of <s>devas</s>, and of humans. 6. Right here, in this very human body, having demonstrated the strength of effort, they display such power of supernatural attainment.' 7. He said: 'May the <s>Bhagavān</s> teach the <s>Dharma</s> for the appearance of this radiance!'

body.text: SaSū(C) 250
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 250

body.text: 1. evam ukte bhagavān bhaiṣajyasenaṃ bodhisatvaṃ mahāsatvam etad avocat: paśyasi tvaṃ bhaiṣajyasena? trisāhasramahāsāhasro lokadhātuḥ ṣaḍvikāraṃ prakaṃpitaḥ! 2. āha: paśyāmi bhagavaṃ paśyāmi sugata. tasya mama bhagavann evaṃ bhavaty; ahaṃ tathāgatam etam arthaṃ paripṛccheyaṃ. 3. bhagavān āha: pṛccha tvaṃ bhaiṣajyasena yad yad evākāṃkṣasy; ahaṃ te tasya tasyaiva praśnasya vyākaraṇena cittam ārādhayiṣyāmi, nirdekṣyāmi, vibhajiṣyāmi. 4. bhaiṣajyasena, yad atītānāgatapratyutpanneṣv adhvasu, tat sarvaṃ darśayiṣyāmi. 5. āha: deśayatu me bhagavān kaukṛtyavinodanārthaṃ. 6. ihāhaṃ bhagavan paśyāmi tathāgataṃ caturaśītibhir devaputrasahasraiḥ parivṛtaṃ, 7. caturaśītibhiḥ koṭīsahasrair bodhisatvaiḥ parivṛtaṃ, 8. dvādaśabhiḥ koṭīsahasrair nāgarājñāṃ parivṛtaṃ, 9. aṣṭādaśabhiḥ koṭīsahasrair bhūtānāṃ parivṛtaṃ, 10. paṃcaviṃśatibhiḥ koṭīsahasraiḥ pretapiśācaiḥ parivṛtaṃ.
body.translated_text: 1. When this was said, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said to the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>: 'Do you see, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>? This trichiliocosm (<s>trisāhasramahāsāhasra lokadhātu</s>) has quaked in six ways!' 2. He said: 'I see, O <s>Bhagavān</s>! I see, O <s>Sugata</s>! This thought occurs to me, O <s>Bhagavān</s>: I would ask the <s>Tathāgata</s> about this matter.' 3. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Ask, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, whatever you wish; I shall satisfy your mind with the answer to each and every question — I shall explain and analyze it. 4. <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, all that pertains to the past, future, and present — all that I shall show you.' 5. He said: 'May the <s>Bhagavān</s> teach me for the removal of remorse (<s>kaukṛtya</s>).' 6. 'Here, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, I see the <s>Tathāgata</s> surrounded by eighty-four thousand <s>devaputras</s> (sons of gods), 7. surrounded by eighty-four thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>bodhisattvas</s>, 8. surrounded by twelve thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>Nāga</s>-kings, 9. surrounded by eighteen thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>bhūtas</s> (spirits), 10. surrounded by twenty-five thousand <s>koṭis</s> of <s>pretas</s> (hungry ghosts) and <s>piśācas</s> (demons).'

body.text: SaSū(C) 251
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 251

body.text: 1. bhagavān āha: nūnam ete bhaiṣajyasena satvāḥ, ya iha parṣadi mamāntike sannipatitā sanniṣaṇṇā dharmaśravaṇāya, ta ete bhaiṣajyasenādyaiva saṃsāraṃ paścānmukhaṃ kariṣyanti; 2. adyaiva daśabhūmipratilābhino bhaviṣyanti; 3. daśabhūmipratiṣṭhitā nirvāṇadhātum anuprāpsyanti; 4. sarvasatvahitaiṣiṇaḥ, jarāmaraṇaparimokṣaṇārthāya kṛtadharmāḥ, sukhāvahāḥ, kleśapāśaṃ nirjitvā, prāpsyante buddhaśāsanqaṃ. 5. āha: kim ete bhagavan satvā, bahūni satvasthānāni nānāvicitraiḥ karmabhir utpannāni? te bhagavantaṃ parivāryāvasthitāni. 6. bhagavān āha: śṛṇu bhaiṣajyasena, āha ca:
body.translated_text: 1. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Surely, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, these beings who have gathered and are seated here in my assembly for the hearing of the <s>Dharma</s> — they, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, this very day will turn their backs on <s>saṃsāra</s>; 2. this very day they will attain the ten <s>bhūmis</s> (stages); 3. established on the ten <s>bhūmis</s>, they will reach the realm of <s>Nirvāṇa</s>; 4. seekers of the welfare of all beings, having accomplished the <s>Dharma</s> for the purpose of liberation from old age and death, bringers of happiness, having overcome the snare of defilements (<s>kleśapāśa</s>), they will attain the teaching of the <s>Buddha</s>.' 5. He said: 'What are these beings, O <s>Bhagavān</s> — born in many being-stations through manifold and various <s>karmas</s>? They stand surrounding the <s>Bhagavān</s>.' 6. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Listen, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>!' And he spoke:

children.text: (1) mūḍhāḥ satvā na jānanti kuto mokṣo bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: (1) Deluded beings do not know whence liberation will come;

children.text: bahavo navakāḥ satvāḥ adya prāpsyanti dhāraṇim //
children.translated_text: many are the new beings who today will attain <s>dhāraṇī</s> (mnemonic retention).

children.text: (2) jñāsyante te sarvadharmān prāptaye daśabhūmināṃ /
children.translated_text: (2) They will know all <s>dharmas</s> for the attainment of the ten <s>bhūmis</s> (stages);

children.text: bhūmayo daśa prāpsyanti buddhakṛtyaṃ kariṣyataḥ //
children.translated_text: they will attain the ten <s>bhūmis</s> and will perform the deeds of a <s>Buddha</s>.

children.text: (3) vartiṣyanti dharmacakraṃ dharmavarṣaṃ pravarṣiṣūḥ /
children.translated_text: (3) They will turn the <s>Dharmacakra</s> (wheel of the Dharma) and will rain down a shower of <s>Dharma</s>;

children.text: ramaṇīyaṃ śāsanaṃ mahyaṃ yena satvāḥ samāgatāḥ //
children.translated_text: delightful is my teaching, by which beings have gathered together.

children.text: (4) devanāgāś ca pretāś ca asurāś ca sudāruṇāḥ /
children.translated_text: (4) <s>Devas</s>, <s>Nāgas</s>, and <s>Pretas</s>, and <s>Asuras</s> most terrible —

children.text: daśabhūmipratiṣṭhante dharmaśabdaparāhatāḥ //
children.translated_text: they become established on the ten <s>bhūmis</s>, struck by the sound of the <s>Dharma</s>.

children.text: (5) dharmabheryāudāharaṃ dharmaśaṃkhaprapūraṇaṃ /
children.translated_text: (5) With the sounding of the <s>Dharma</s>-drum and the blowing of the <s>Dharma</s>-conch,

children.text: adyaiṣāṃ navasatvānāṃ vīryasthāmo bhaviṣyati //
children.translated_text: today for these new beings there will arise strength and vigor.

body.text: (6) dharmaṃ prāpsyanti adyeme yathā prāptaṃ tathāgataiḥ //
body.translated_text: (6) Today these beings will attain the <s>Dharma</s>, just as it was attained by the <s>Tathāgatas</s>.

body.text: SaSū(C) 252
body.translated_text: Then approximately five thousand young beings, rising from their seats, extending their palms toward the <s>Bhagavān</s> and bowing, said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>:

body.text: 1. atha paṃcamātrāṇi sahasrāṇi daharāṇāṃ satvānām utthāyāsanebhyo, yena bhagavāṃs tenāṃjaliṃ praṇamya, bhagavantam etad avocan:

children.text: (1) gurubhāro bhagavan kāyo dāruṇaś ca mahābhayaḥ /
children.translated_text: (1) 'Heavy is the burden of the body, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, terrible and full of great fear;

children.text: saṃsāre yena badhyāmaḥ paryantam avijānakāḥ //
children.translated_text: by which we are bound in <s>saṃsāra</s>, not knowing its end.

children.text: (2) mārgan tu na vijānāmo mārgam eva na dṛśyate /
children.translated_text: (2) We do not know the path, the path itself is not seen;

children.text: andhabhūtā vayaṃ nātha asmākaṃ kuru saṃgrahaṃ //
children.translated_text: we are become blind, O Protector — gather us in, take care of us.

children.text: (3) adhyeṣāma vayaṃ vīra dharman deśaya nāyaka /
children.translated_text: (3) We beseech you, O Hero, teach us the <s>Dharma</s>, O Leader!

children.text: alpaprajñā vayaṃ jātā anabhijñāḥ sukhasya hi //
children.translated_text: We are born with little wisdom, ignorant indeed of happiness.

children.text: (4) dharman deśaya asmākaṃ duḥkhān mocaya dāruṇāt /
children.translated_text: (4) Teach the <s>Dharma</s> to us, liberate us from terrible suffering!

children.text: yatra yatropapadyema syād asmād buddhadarśanam //
children.translated_text: Wherever we may be reborn, may we have the sight of the <s>Buddha</s>!

body.text: SaSū(C) 253
body.translated_text: Then the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Bhaiṣajyasena</s> approached those young beings, and having approached, said this:

body.text: 1. atha khalu bhaiṣajyaseno bodhisatvo mahāsatvo, yena te daharā satvās tenopasaṃkrānta, upasaṃkramya, etad avocat:

children.text: (1) bhūṃjadhvaṃ bhojanaṃ yūyaṃ pivadhvaṃ rasam adbhutam /
children.translated_text: (1) 'Eat this food, all of you, and drink this wondrous nectar;

children.text: paścād viśāradā bhūtvā dharmaṃ śroṣyatha nirbhayaṃ //
children.translated_text: afterward, having become confident, you shall hear the <s>Dharma</s> fearlessly.'

children.text: 2. ta āhuḥ:
children.translated_text: They said:

children.text: (2) bhadanta sthavira kas tvaṃ na jānīmo vayaṃ tava /
children.translated_text: (2) 'Venerable elder, who are you? We do not know you.

children.text: prāsādikaṃ tvāṃ paśyāmaḥ śāntarūpaṃ mahāyaśaḥ //
children.translated_text: We see you as inspiring faith, of peaceful form, of great renown.

children.text: (3) muktaṃ narakatiryakṣu pretalokān mahābhayāt /
children.translated_text: (3) You are freed from the hells and animal realms, from the world of <s>Pretas</s> and from great fear;

children.text: śāntā te sarvapāpāni yathā jagati śobhase //
children.translated_text: all your evil deeds are stilled — how you shine in the world!

children.text: (4) paśyāma haste karakaṃ saptaratnasamanvitam /
children.translated_text: (4) We see in your hand a vessel adorned with the seven jewels,

children.text: sūtraṃ ratnāmayaṃ kāye tejarāśau viveṣṭitaṃ //
children.translated_text: and a thread of jewels upon your body, wrapped in a mass of radiance.

children.text: (5) prativoḍhuṃ na śaktā smaḥ śāntavākyasya te vacaḥ /
children.translated_text: (5) We are unable to repay your words of peaceful speech;

children.text: bhaktena kāryaṃ nāsmākaṃ pānena svādunā na ca //
children.translated_text: we have no need of food, nor of sweet drink.

children.text: (6) bhaktād uccāra saṃbhavati pānān mūtraṃ tathaiva ca /
children.translated_text: (6) From food arises excrement, and from drink arises urine likewise;

children.text: śoṇitaṃ ca rasād bhavati raktān māṃsaṃ ca saṃbhavet //
children.translated_text: from fluids arises blood, and from blood arises flesh.

children.text: (7) nāsmākaṃ bhojanaṃ kāryaṃ pānenaiva ca saṃskṛtaṃ /
children.translated_text: (7) We have no need of food, nor of prepared drink;

children.text: vastrāṇi naiva sūkṣmāṇi paṭṭāpaṭṭakasaṃhitā //
children.translated_text: nor of fine garments, whether silk or cotton cloth.

children.text: (8) kaṭakāś ca na sauvarṇāḥ kāryā muktilatā na ca /
children.translated_text: (8) Nor are golden bracelets needed, nor pearl necklaces,

children.text: aṅgulīyair naiva kāryaṃ sarve te 'nityadharmiṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: nor is there need of finger-rings — all these are subject to impermanence.

children.text: (9) jīvitair arthikāś ca smaḥ na ca gacchema durgatim /
children.translated_text: (9) We desire life, yet may we not go to the lower realms;

children.text: arthikā dharmadānena na devānāṃ sukhair api //
children.translated_text: we desire the gift of <s>Dharma</s>, not even the pleasures of the <s>Devas</s>.

children.text: (10) kalyāṇamitratā kāryā na rājyaṃ cakravartināṃ /
children.translated_text: (10) Association with spiritual friends (<s>kalyāṇamitra</s>) is what is needed, not the kingdom of <s>Cakravartins</s> (universal monarchs);

children.text: cakravartī mariṣyanti tyaktvā dvīpān suśobhanān //
children.translated_text: <s>Cakravartins</s> will die, having abandoned their beautiful continents.

children.text: (11) na putrāḥ pṛṣṭhato yānti na bhāryā na ca dhītarāḥ /
children.translated_text: (11) Sons do not follow behind, nor wives, nor daughters;

children.text: saptaratnā nivartyante nāpi yāsyanti pṛṣṭhataḥ //
children.translated_text: the seven jewels turn back, nor will they follow behind.

children.text: (12) sannipātya bahujano na ca yāsyanti pṛṣṭhataḥ /
children.translated_text: (12) Though many people have gathered, they will not follow behind;

children.text: purataś ca na dhāvante vaśaṃ bhūyo na vartate //
children.translated_text: they do not run ahead, and no longer remain under one's power.

children.text: (13) ekajanmikarājāno bhrāmitā nityayā bahu /
children.translated_text: (13) Kings of a single lifetime, having wandered long through perpetual existence —

children.text: kṛtvā pāpāni karmāṇi raurave prapatanti te //
children.translated_text: having committed evil deeds, they fall into <s>Raurava</s> (the Screaming Hell).

children.text: (14) caturdiśaṃ paryaṭitvā saptaratnair mahardhikaiḥ /
children.translated_text: (14) Having traversed the four directions with the seven treasures of great supernatural power,

children.text: yāsyate kva ca sā ṛddhir yadā vatsyati raurave //
children.translated_text: where will that power go when one dwells in <s>Raurava</s>?

children.text: (15) mṛtā ṛddhiṃ na śaknonti yatra bhūmir na vidyate /
children.translated_text: (15) The dead cannot exercise their supernatural power where no ground exists.

children.text: sthavira śṛṇuṣva asmākaṃ gaccha yena tathāgataḥ //
children.translated_text: O Elder, listen to us — go to where the <s>Tathāgata</s> is!

children.text: (16) kāṃkṣāma darśanaṃ tasya mātāpitror yathaiva hi /
children.translated_text: (16) We long for the sight of him, just as one longs for mother and father.

children.text: nāsmākaṃ vidyate mātā na pitā bhrātarau na ca //
children.translated_text: We have no mother, no father, no brothers.

children.text: (17) saiva lokagurur mātā pitā caiva tathāgataḥ /
children.translated_text: (17) The <s>Tathāgata</s> alone is mother and father, the teacher of the world;

children.text: saiva candraś ca sūryaś ca kṣemamārgapradarśakaḥ //
children.translated_text: he alone is the moon and the sun, the one who shows the path to safety.

children.text: (18) mocakaḥ sa hi saṃsārād yena bhūyo na jāyate /
children.translated_text: (18) He is the liberator from <s>saṃsāra</s>, through whom one is not born again;

children.text: sa nāvātārako oghāt kleśaughāc ca mahābhayāt //
children.translated_text: he is the one who ferries across the flood, across the great and fearful flood of <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions).

children.text: (19) tena pratāritāḥ satvāḥ na bhūyo vinivartitā /
children.translated_text: (19) The beings ferried across by him do not turn back again;

children.text: saddharmo deśitas tena agrabodhipradarśakaḥ //
children.translated_text: the true <s>Dharma</s> was taught by him, the one who reveals supreme <s>Bodhi</s> (awakening).

children.text: (20) nāsmākaṃ bhojanenārtho na rājyaphalakāṃkṣiṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: (20) We have no need of food, nor do we desire the fruit of kingship;

children.text: na devalokagamanaṃ kāryaṃ narakabhīrubhiḥ //
children.translated_text: nor should going to the world of the <s>Devas</s> be sought by those who fear the hells.

children.text: (21) sukhaṃ mānuṣyakaṃ janma dṛśyate yatra sarvavit /
children.translated_text: (21) Fortunate is human birth, where the All-Knowing One is seen;

children.text: alpāyuṣāś ca dṛśyante duṣkṛtaiḥ karmabhiḥ svakaiḥ //
children.translated_text: yet beings of short lifespan are seen, due to their own evil deeds.

children.text: (22) rajyante kāmabhogais te vindanti maraṇaṃ na ca /
children.translated_text: (22) They delight in sensual pleasures and do not perceive death;

children.text: jānanti na ca bhāyante nirodhotpādavāṃcitāḥ //
children.translated_text: they neither know nor fear, deceived about cessation and arising.

children.text: (23) sūkṣmān dharmān na jānanti sūkṣmaṃ kāryaṃ na kurvante /
children.translated_text: (23) They do not know the subtle <s>dharmas</s>, they do not perform subtle deeds;

children.text: śāntaṃ dhātuṃ na jānanti avidyākrāntacetasaḥ //
children.translated_text: they do not know the peaceful element (<s>śānta dhātu</s>), their minds being overcome by ignorance (<s>avidyā</s>).

children.text: (24) cyavanto na ca khidyante jāyantaś ca punaḥ punaḥ /
children.translated_text: (24) Passing away, they are not distressed, being born again and again;

children.text: dīrgharātraṃ duḥkhahatā nityatā daṇḍatāḍitāḥ //
children.translated_text: through the long night they are afflicted by suffering, constantly beaten by the rod of perpetual existence.

children.text: (25) parakīyaṃ hariṣyanti ghātyante bandhane tathā /
children.translated_text: (25) They will steal what belongs to others, and are killed and imprisoned likewise;

children.text: paṃcabandhanabaddhās te pūrvapāpena coditāḥ //
children.translated_text: bound by the five bonds, they are impelled by their former evil deeds.

children.text: (26) nirāśāś ca mariṣyanti śokaśalyasamarpitā /
children.translated_text: (26) Hopeless, they will die, pierced by the arrow of grief;

children.text: niruddhyamāne vijñāne karuṇaṃ paridevate //
children.translated_text: when consciousness is being extinguished, they lament pitifully.

children.text: (27) ko nu trātā bhaveyur me sarvān bhogān dadāmy ahaṃ /
children.translated_text: (27) "Who could be my saviors? I will give all my possessions —

children.text: suvarṇarupyasphaṭikaṃ dāso 'pi ca bhavāmy ahaṃ //
children.translated_text: gold, silver, and crystal — and I will even become a slave!

children.text: (28) sarvaṃ karma kariṣyāmi dāsayogyaṃ ca yad bhavet /
children.translated_text: (28) I will perform all tasks, whatever work befits a servant;

children.text: na rājyabhogair me kāryaṃ na dhānyena dhanena ca //
children.translated_text: I have no need of royal enjoyments, nor of grain, nor of wealth."

children.text: (29) svaśarīreṇa me kāryaṃ pāpakārī na mucyate /
children.translated_text: (29) "My own body is what concerns me" — yet the evil-doer is not freed.

children.text: evaṃ hi sthavirāsmākaṃ na kāryaṃ bhojanaṃ bhavet //
children.translated_text: Thus, O Elder, food is of no use to us.

children.text: (30) rājāno 'pi mariṣyanti yair bhuktaṃ mṛṣṭabhojanam /
children.translated_text: (30) Kings too will die, who have eaten fine food;

children.text: devaputrā mariṣyanti pītvā vai pānam uttamam //
children.translated_text: sons of the gods will die, having drunk the finest drink.

children.text: (31) nānārasamāyuktaṃ saṃskṛtaṃ pānabhojanam /
children.translated_text: (31) Food and drink prepared with various flavors —

children.text: ānīya purato rājā jihvayā spṛśati bhojana //
children.translated_text: a king has it brought before him and touches the food with his tongue.

children.text: (32) rasagṛddhā hi rājānaḥ pāpaṃ kurvanty analpakaṃ /
children.translated_text: (32) Kings who are greedy for taste commit no small amount of evil;

children.text: rajyanty anityehi rasehi yatra sāraṃ na vidyate //
children.translated_text: they delight in impermanent flavors where no essence is found.

children.text: (33) pānaṃ na kāryam asmākaṃ na ca kāryaṃ hi bhojanaṃ /
children.translated_text: (33) Drink is of no use to us, nor is food of any use;

children.text: dharmatā īdṛśī kāryā duḥkhān mucyema yad vayam //
children.translated_text: this is the practice (<s>dharmatā</s>) that should be undertaken — that we may be freed from suffering.

children.text: (34) tṛṣṇābandhananirmuktaṃ tṛṣṇākleśavimokṣanam /
children.translated_text: (34) He who is freed from the bonds of craving (<s>tṛṣṇā</s>), who grants liberation from the affliction of craving,

children.text: sarvabandhananirmuktaṃ taṃ buddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ //
children.translated_text: who is freed from all bonds — to that <s>Buddha</s> we have gone for refuge.

children.text: (35) vayaṃ hi śaraṇaṃ yāmo lokanāthaṃ maharṣiṇam /
children.translated_text: (35) We go for refuge to the Protector of the World, the Great Sage;

children.text: vandanāya vayaṃ yāmaḥ satvānāṃ priyadarśanam //
children.translated_text: we go to pay homage to him who is dear to behold for all beings.

body.text: (36) nāmaṃ tava na jānīmo nāmam ācakṣva śobhanaṃ /
body.translated_text: (36) We do not know your name — tell us your beautiful name!'

body.text:
3. bhaiṣajyaseno bodhisatva āha:
(36) yūyaṃ hi śrotum icchadhvaṃ nāmaṃ sarvajanasya ca //
body.translated_text: The <s>bodhisattva Bhaiṣajyasena</s> said: (36) 'You wish to hear the name of all people?'

body.text: (37) vṛtaḥ koṭīśatasahasrair navakaiḥ satvais tathāgataḥ /
body.translated_text: (37) 'The <s>Tathāgata</s> is surrounded by hundreds of thousands of <s>koṭīs</s> of new beings.'

body.text:
4. ta āhuḥ:
(37) tava tu śrotum icchāmo nāmaṃ sarvaguṇodbhavaṃ //
body.translated_text: They said: (37) 'We wish to hear your name, the source of all virtues.'

body.text:
(38) gaṃbhīraṃ śrūyate nāma yas tvaṃ buddhānā śrāvakaḥ 5. āha:
(38) bhaiṣajyaseno nāmnāhaṃ satvānāṃ bhaiṣajyo hy ahaṃ //
body.translated_text: (38) 'A profound name is heard — that you are a disciple of the <s>Buddhas</s>.' He said: (38) '<s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s> is my name; I am a healer of beings.

children.text: (39) yuṣmākaṃ deśayaiṣyāmi sarveṣām auṣadhaṃ varaṃ /
children.translated_text: (39) I will teach you all the supreme medicine,

children.text: sarvavyādhipraśamanaṃ sarvavyādhihate jane //
children.translated_text: that which calms all diseases, for people afflicted by all diseases.

children.text: (40) rāgo vyādhir mahāvyādhir loke naśyati dāruṇaṃ /
children.translated_text: (40) <s>Rāga</s> (passion) is a disease, a great disease; it destroys terribly in the world.

children.text: moho vyādhir mahāghoro yena bhrāmyanty abuddhayaḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Moha</s> (delusion) is a disease, most fearsome, by which the unwise wander.

children.text: (41) vrajanti narakaṃ satvās tiryakpreteṣu vai tathā /
children.translated_text: (41) Beings go to the hells, and to the animal and <s>Preta</s> realms likewise;

children.text: dveṣagrastā ime bālās teṣāṃ śāntiḥ kathaṃ bhavet //
children.translated_text: these fools are seized by hatred (<s>dveṣa</s>) — how shall peace come to them?'

children.text: 6. ta āhuḥ:
children.translated_text: They said:

children.text: (42) mucyema sarvaduḥkhātaḥ śrutvā dharmam imaṃ śubhaṃ /
children.translated_text: (42) 'May we be freed from all suffering, having heard this excellent <s>Dharma</s>;

children.text: muktāś ca sarvaduḥkhebhyo bālabuddhim ajānakāḥ //
children.translated_text: freed from all sufferings, we who are ignorant, not knowing the wisdom of the childish.

children.text: (43) śroṣyāmahe dharmadānaṃ pāpakarmavivarjitāḥ /
children.translated_text: (43) We shall hear the gift of <s>Dharma</s>, having abandoned evil deeds;

children.text: sarvapāpaṃ vivarjitvā prahīṇabhayabhairavāḥ //
children.translated_text: having renounced all evil, with fear and terror abandoned.

children.text: (44) drakṣyāma śīghraṃ saṃbuddhaṃ sarvavyādhipramocakaṃ /
children.translated_text: (44) May we quickly see the Fully Awakened One (<s>Sambuddha</s>), the liberator from all diseases,

children.text: vaidyarājaṃ mahāvaidyaṃ duḥkhitānāṃ cikitsakaṃ //
children.translated_text: the King of Physicians, the Great Physician, the healer of those who suffer.

children.text: (45) gaccha sthavira śīghraṃ tvaṃ vandanāya tathāgataṃ /
children.translated_text: (45) Go quickly, O Elder, to pay homage to the <s>Tathāgata</s>;

children.text: vandasva cāsmadvacanā brūhi lokavināyakaṃ //
children.translated_text: pay homage on our behalf, and speak to the Guide of the World.

children.text: (46) praśāmaya imaṃ vyādhiṃ śamayāgniṃ sudāruṇam /
children.translated_text: (46) May he calm this disease, may he quench this terrible fire;

children.text: kāyo 'yaṃ jvalitaḥ sarvo dahyamāno na śāmyate //
children.translated_text: this entire body is ablaze, burning and finding no relief.

children.text: (47) duḥkhārditānām asmākaṃ kāryuṇyaṃ kuru suvrata /
children.translated_text: (47) For us who are afflicted by suffering, show compassion, O virtuous one;

children.text: kāyabhāro mahābhāras tīkṣṇabhāraḥ sudāruṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: the burden of the body is a great burden, a sharp burden, most terrible.

children.text: (48) dveṣamohasamākrāntā udvahanti janāḥ sadā /
children.translated_text: (48) Overcome by hatred and delusion, people always carry this burden;'

children.text: punaḥ punar vahanty ete mokṣadvāram ajānakāḥ //
children.translated_text: Again and again they carry on, these who do not know the door to liberation.

children.text: (49) martavyaṃ na vijānante trāso notpadyate 'tha ca /
children.translated_text: (49) They do not know that they must die, and yet no terror arises [in them];

children.text: mokṣamārgaṃ ajānānā mokṣamārgam apaśyakāḥ //
children.translated_text: not knowing the path to liberation, not seeing the path to liberation.

children.text: (50) asmākaṃ maraṇaṃ nāsti kadācid iti susthitāḥ /
children.translated_text: (50) 'There is no death for us at any time' — thus firmly established [in delusion],

children.text: saṃbhrāntā na vijānanti paśyanto mātaraṃ mṛtām //
children.translated_text: bewildered, they do not understand, even seeing their mother dead.

children.text: (51) pitaraṃ na smaranty anye nityaṃ ca vyādhipīḍitāḥ /
children.translated_text: (51) Others do not remember their father, constantly afflicted by disease;

children.text: kleśakarmapraluḍitāḥ kathaṃ bhūṃjāma bhojanaṃ //
children.translated_text: crushed by afflictions (<s>kleśas</s>) and <s>karma</s> — 'How shall we eat food?'

children.text: (52) duḥkhāntaṃ na vijānāmaḥ śramāmo 'tha nirarthakaṃ /
children.translated_text: (52) 'We do not know the end of suffering; we toil, yet it is purposeless;

children.text: asmākam īdṛśā duḥkhā jātyavidyānidānataḥ //
children.translated_text: such sufferings of ours arise from the cause of birth and ignorance (<s>avidyā</s>).'

children.text: (53) mahābhayaṃ gurubhāraṃ saṃjñāsaṃskāravedanā /
children.translated_text: (53) Great fear, heavy burden — perception (<s>saṃjñā</s>), formations (<s>saṃskāras</s>), and sensation (<s>vedanā</s>);

children.text: tṛṣṇāyā bhrāmyate bālo yo dharmaṃ na vijānate //
children.translated_text: the fool who does not know the <s>Dharma</s> wanders [in <s>saṃsāra</s>] by craving (<s>tṛṣṇā</s>).

children.text: (54) jāto loke hy anarthāya kāyabhāraparivṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: (54) Born in the world for no purpose, burdened by the weight of the body,

children.text: snānānulepanaiḥ kāryaṃ śucir vastraṃ suśobhanaṃ //
children.translated_text: [one must attend to] bathing and anointing, clean and beautifully adorned garments.

children.text: (55) mṛṣṭaṃ ca bhojanaṃ kāryaṃ yac charīre manoramaṃ /
children.translated_text: (55) Fine food must be provided, whatever is pleasing to the body;

children.text: paṃcatūryā manojñaṃ ca śrotraṃ yācayate tathā //
children.translated_text: likewise the ear craves for the pleasant [sounds of] musical instruments.

children.text: (56) saptaratnasamutthāne rūpe rajyanti cakṣuṣī /
children.translated_text: (56) The eyes are delighted by forms arising from the seven jewels;

children.text: sarvaṃ rasaṃ ca mṛṣṭaṃ ca jihvā yācayate 'pi ca //
children.translated_text: the tongue too craves for every taste, both savory and sweet.

children.text: (57) sparśaṃ ca mṛdukaṃ sūkṣmaṃ kāyaḥ prārthayate sadā /
children.translated_text: (57) The body always desires touch that is soft and delicate;

children.text: māṃsadvayaṃ śarīreṇa niṣpīḍya ratī jāyate //
children.translated_text: pleasure arises from pressing together two [pieces of] flesh with the body.

children.text: (58) kāyo hy acetano 'py eṣa ratiṃ kas tatra vindati /
children.translated_text: (58) Yet this body is itself unconscious — who finds pleasure in it?

children.text: pādau me ramatas tatra prāvṛtaṃ carma sundaraṃ //
children.translated_text: My feet delight there — wrapped in beautiful skin.

children.text: (59) bhavanti maraṇe trāṇaṃ na vastraṃ na vilepanam /
children.translated_text: (59) At death, there is no protection — neither garments nor ointments;

children.text: bhavec charīraṃ na trāṇaṃ kiṃ punar vastralepanaṃ //
children.translated_text: can the body be a protection? How much less garments and ointments!

children.text: (60) puruṣa ucyate kāyam eti śvāsaṃ mahābalaṃ /
children.translated_text: (60) What is called 'a person' is the body — breath of great power moves through it;

children.text: tīkṣṇaṃ balaṃ pratisaṃkhyā taṃ taccharīre mahāguṇaṃ //
children.translated_text: reflecting on that sharp power, that great quality in the body.

children.text: (61) krīḍayā bhrāmitaḥ pūrvam aśvahastiparivṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: (61) Formerly I was deluded by play, surrounded by horses and elephants;

children.text: mokṣadharmam ajānāno rato 'haṃ pāpakarmaṇi //
children.translated_text: not knowing the <s>Dharma</s> of liberation, I delighted in sinful deeds.

children.text: (62) krīḍyā kārāpitaṃ pāpaṃ paralokam ajānatā /
children.translated_text: (62) Evil was done through play, by one not knowing the next world;

children.text: punaḥ punaś ca jāto 'haṃ punar maraṇam āgataḥ //
children.translated_text: again and again was I born, and again death came.

children.text: (63) śokaḥ punaḥ punar dṛṣṭaṃ paridevitabandhanaṃ /
children.translated_text: (63) Grief was seen again and again, and the bondage of lamentation;

children.text: mātṝṇāṃ maraṇaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ dṛṣṭāś ca pitaro mṛtā //
children.translated_text: the death of mothers was seen, and fathers were seen dead.

children.text: (64) jñātayo bhaginī caiva putrā bhāryā mṛtāpi ca /
children.translated_text: (64) Relatives and sisters, sons and wives — also dead;

children.text: śūnyāḥ sarve hi saṃskārāḥ ko hi rajyet sacetanaḥ //
children.translated_text: all formations (<s>saṃskāras</s>) are indeed empty — what conscious being could take delight?

children.text: (65) viśvāsaṃ hi mayājñātaṃ lobhagrastena cetasā /
children.translated_text: (65) Trustworthiness was not known by me, my mind seized by greed;

children.text: śāntaṃ dharmaṃ nopalabdhaṃ maraṇaṃ nābhinanditaṃ //
children.translated_text: the peaceful <s>Dharma</s> was not attained; death was not welcomed.

children.text: (66) tena dānaṃ na dattaṃ me lobhenāvṛtacetasā /
children.translated_text: (66) Therefore no gift (<s>dāna</s>) was given by me, my mind obscured by greed;

children.text: kaḥ syā lobhasamo pāpo yo 'dyāpi na nivartate //
children.translated_text: what evil is equal to greed, which even now does not turn back?

children.text: (67) saṃbhrāntā hi vayaṃ jātāḥ saṃbhrāntaṃ sakalaṃ jagat /
children.translated_text: (67) Bewildered indeed were we born; bewildered is the entire world;

children.text: saṃbhrāntāḥ śabdaṃ śṛṇumo asaddharmaparigrahaṃ //
children.translated_text: bewildered, we hear the sound of the acceptance of false <s>dharma</s>.

children.text: (68) mokṣaṃ dhyānāś ca margāmaḥ śarīraṃ nodvahāmahe /
children.translated_text: (68) May we seek liberation and meditation (<s>dhyāna</s>)! May we not bear this body [in vain]!

children.text: buddhā bhavema lokārthe śāstāro guravo jage //
children.translated_text: May we become <s>Buddhas</s> for the sake of the world — teachers and guides in the world!

children.text: (69) buddho mātāpitā loke buddho mārgapradarśakaḥ /
children.translated_text: (69) The <s>Buddha</s> is mother and father in the world; the <s>Buddha</s> is the one who shows the path;

children.text: pravarṣate dharmavarṣaṃ jaṃbudvīpe samantataḥ //
children.translated_text: he rains the rain of <s>Dharma</s> upon <s>Jambudvīpa</s> on all sides.

children.text: (70) mūḍhā satvā na jānanti dharmāṇāṃ saṃgrahaṃ kathaṃ /
children.translated_text: (70) Deluded beings do not know how to gather the <s>dharmas</s>;

children.text: bodhau cittaṃ nāmayitvā labhyate dharmasaṃgrahaḥ //
children.translated_text: by bending the mind toward awakening (<s>bodhi</s>), the gathering of <s>dharmas</s> is attained.

children.text: (71) śūnyatāḥ sarvasaṃkārāḥ śūnyā bhogā dhanaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: (71) All formations (<s>saṃskāras</s>) are empty; enjoyments and wealth are likewise empty;

children.text: paśyāma śūnyam ātmānaṃ dṛṣṭvā jātā nirāśatā //
children.translated_text: we see the self as empty — having seen this, dispassion has arisen.

children.text: (72) sthavira bhaiṣajyasenamasmākaṃ vacanaṃ śṛṇu /
children.translated_text: (72) 'Elder <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, hear our words;

children.text: dūraṃ ca te visarjemo bodhisatvāna kāraṇāt //
children.translated_text: we send you forth far away, for the sake of the <s>bodhisattvas</s>.'

children.text: (73) bodhisatvā na khidyante vīryavanto mahātapāḥ /
children.translated_text: (73) '<s>Bodhisattvas</s> do not become weary — they are vigorous and of great austerity;

children.text: smṛtvā saṃsāradoṣāṇi kurvante guṇasaṃgrahaṃ //
children.translated_text: remembering the faults of <s>saṃsāra</s>, they gather virtues.'

children.text: (74) gacchasva yena śāstāsau pṛccha cāsmāka kāranāt /
children.translated_text: (74) 'Go to where that Teacher is, and ask on our behalf;

children.text: pratibuddhā sukhaṃ śāstā mā kiṃcit khidyate jinaḥ //
children.translated_text: "Is the awakened Teacher at ease? May the <s>Jina</s> (Conqueror) not be wearied in any way!"'

children.text: (75) parājitas tvayā māraḥ sabalaś ca savāhanaḥ /
children.translated_text: (75) '"<s>Māra</s>, with his army and his host, has been defeated by you;

children.text: śīghram ujvālitaṃ dharmaṃ sarvasatvasukhāvahaṃ //
children.translated_text: quickly has the <s>Dharma</s> been illuminated, bringing happiness to all beings."'

children.text: (76) na cāsmābhiḥ śruto dharmo yena buddhā bhavemahe /
children.translated_text: (76) '"But we have not heard the <s>Dharma</s> by which we may become <s>Buddhas</s>;

children.text: gacchasva śīghraṃ sthavira asmākaṃ hitakāraṇāt //
children.translated_text: go quickly, O elder, for the sake of our benefit!"'

children.text: (77) nottarāmo vayaṃ yāvan na paśyāmas tathāgataṃ /
children.translated_text: (77) '"We shall not rise up until we see the <s>Tathāgata</s>,

children.text: dvātṛṃśalakṣaṇadharaṃ sthitā sarve sagauravāḥ //
children.translated_text: the bearer of the thirty-two marks — we all stand here with reverence."'

children.text: 7. bhaiṣajyaseno bodhisatva āha:
children.translated_text: 7. The <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s> said:

children.text: (88) ūrdhvaṃ tāvan nirīkṣadhvaṃ kiṃ paśyadhvaṃ hi sāṃprataṃ /
children.translated_text: (78) 'Look upward now! What do you see at this moment?'

children.text: (79) avalokayanti te ūrdhvaṃ sthitāḥ paṃca anūnakāḥ /
children.translated_text: (79) Those five complete [groups], standing there, looked upward;

children.text: śatās trayaḥ sahasrāṇi kūṭāgārāḥ samantataḥ //
children.translated_text: [they saw] three hundred thousand peaked mansions (<s>kūṭāgāras</s>) on all sides,

children.text: (80) saptaratnasamārūḍhā ratnajālasvalaṃkṛtāḥ /
children.translated_text: (80) adorned with the seven jewels, beautifully decorated with nets of gems;

children.text: padmaṃ praphullaṃ madhye ca divyagandhapramuñcanaṃ //
children.translated_text: in the midst, a lotus in full bloom, releasing divine fragrance.

children.text: (81) pṛcchanti sthaviraṃ tatra kim etad iha dṛśyate /
children.translated_text: (81) They ask the elder there: 'What is this that is seen here —

children.text: kūṭāgārā ratnajālāḥ padmakesarasaṃsthitāḥ //
children.translated_text: peaked mansions with nets of gems, established upon lotus filaments?'

children.text: 8. bhaiṣajayasena āha:
children.translated_text: 8. <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s> said:

children.text: (82) sthānāny etāni yuṣmākaṃ gacchadhvaṃ buddhadarśanaṃ /
children.translated_text: (82) 'These are your abodes! Go for the sight of the <s>Buddha</s>;

children.text: vandadhvaṃ lokapradyotaṃ yo 'sau lokottaro guruḥ //
children.translated_text: pay homage to the Light of the World, that supramundane Teacher!'

children.text: 9. ta āhuḥ:
children.translated_text: 9. They said:

children.text: (83) tatra mārgaṃ na jānīmo na paśyāmas tathāgataṃ /
children.translated_text: (83) 'We do not know the path there; we do not see the <s>Tathāgata</s>;

children.text: yatra mārgaṃ na jānīmaḥ kutra gacchāma vanditum //
children.translated_text: where we do not know the path, where shall we go to pay homage?'

children.text: 10. bhaiṣajyasena āha:
children.translated_text: 10. <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s> said:

children.text: (84) vandanāya ca gantavyaṃ śāstāram amṛtaprabhaṃ /
children.translated_text: (84) 'One should go for homage to the Teacher of immortal radiance;

children.text: anantam ākāśam iva parāmārṣṭuṃ na śakyate //
children.translated_text: like infinite space, he cannot be grasped.'

children.text: (85) sthāne tiṣṭhaty asau śāstā yathā tiṣṭhanti meravaḥ /
children.translated_text: (85) 'That Teacher abides in his station, just as the <s>Merus</s> stand;

children.text: sumeror upamā syāt tu gādhaṃ caiva mahodadheḥ //
children.translated_text: a comparison might be made to <s>Sumeru</s> and to the depths of the great ocean.'

children.text: (86) trsāhasrāc ca rajaso na jñānād buddhasaṃbhavāt /
children.translated_text: (86) 'Beyond the dust of the <s>trisāhasra</s> (trichiliocosm), not from [mere] knowledge does the <s>Buddha</s> arise;

children.text: vandito lokapradyoto bodhisatvair daśaddiśaḥ //
children.translated_text: the Light of the World is worshipped by <s>bodhisattvas</s> from the ten directions.'

body.text: 11. ta āhuḥ:
body.translated_text: 11. They said:

children.text: (87) vilokaya lokanātha pūrayāsmakam āśayaṃ /
children.translated_text: (87) 'Look upon us, O Lord of the World! Fulfill our aspiration;

children.text: cittena vandito 'smābhiḥ śāstā labdhās tataḥ phalaṃ //
children.translated_text: with our minds we have worshipped the Teacher — may we obtain the fruit thereby!'

children.text: 12. bhaiṣajyaseno bodhisatva āha:
children.translated_text: 12. The <s>bodhisattva</s> <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s> said:

children.text: (88) na gandhai rajyate śāstā na mālyair na /
children.translated_text: (88) 'The Teacher is not delighted by fragrances, nor by garlands, nor by

children.text: vilepanaiḥ hetuṃ gṛhṇāti satvānāṃ yena mucyanti saṃskṛtāt //
children.translated_text: ointments; he grasps the cause by which beings are freed from the conditioned (<s>saṃskṛta</s>).'

children.text: (89) saṃgrāmaṃ na kurute tasya māraḥ paramadāruṇaṃ /
children.translated_text: (89) '<s>Māra</s>, most terrible, does not wage war against him

children.text: damito hi mano yena buddhaṃ ca śaraṇaṃ gataḥ //
children.translated_text: whose mind is tamed and who has gone to the <s>Buddha</s> for refuge.'

children.text: (90) mṛtyor na yāsyati vaśaṃ kṣipraṃ prāpsyati dhāraṇīḥ /
children.translated_text: (90) 'He will not come under the power of death; he will quickly attain <s>dhāraṇīs</s> (retentive powers);

children.text: cittaprasādaṃ kṛtvāsau śāstāraṃ paśyate tataḥ //
children.translated_text: having generated faith of mind (<s>cittaprasāda</s>), he will then see the Teacher.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 254

1. atha khalu kalaviṅkarutasvaramanojñaghoṣas tathāgataḥ smitaṃ prāduścakāra. 2. atha khalu bhaiṣajyaseno bodhisatvo mahāsatva utthāyāsanād, yena bhagavāṃs tenāṃjaliṃ praṇamya, bhagavantam etad avocat: ko bhagavan hetuḥ kaḥ pratyayaḥ smitasya prāduṣkaraṇāya yad bhagavato mukhadvārāc caturaśītiraśmisahasrāṇi niścaranti? 3. taiś ca raśmibhiḥ trisāhasramahāsāhasrī lokadhātur avabhāsena sphuṭābhūt, 4. sarve ca dvātṛṃśan mahānirayā sphuṭā abhūvan, 5. dvātṛṃśatiś ca devabhavanāny avabhāsitāni, 6. tāś ca raśmayo nānāvarṇāḥ tadyathā nīlapītalohitāvadātamaṃjiṣṭhāsphaṭikarajatavarṇāḥ, 7. etāśca raśmayo bhagavato mukhadvārān niścarya, trisāhasramahāsāhasryāṃ lokadhātau sarvamukhopadhānaṃ kṛtvā, punar eva pratyudāvṛtya, bhagavantaṃ saptakṛt pradakṣiṇīkṛtya, bhagavato mūrdhany antaradhīyanta.
body.translated_text: 1. Then the <s>Tathāgata</s> <s>Kalaviṅka-ruta-svara-manojña-ghoṣa</s> (He Whose Voice has the Pleasant Sound of the <s>Kalaviṅka</s> Bird) displayed a smile. 2. Then the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, having risen from his seat, extending his palms toward the <s>Bhagavān</s> and bowing, said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'What, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, is the cause, what is the condition for the display of this smile, that eighty-four thousand rays of light issue forth from the <s>Bhagavān</s>'s mouth?' 3. And by those rays the <s>trisāhasra-mahāsāhasrī</s> (billion-fold) world-system was pervaded with radiance, 4. and all thirty-two great hells were illuminated, 5. and thirty-two divine palaces were illuminated, 6. and those rays were of various colors — namely, blue, yellow, red, white, crimson, crystal, and silver. 7. And those rays, having issued from the <s>Bhagavān</s>'s mouth, having created a pillow of light upon every face in the <s>trisāhasra-mahāsāhasrī</s> world-system, returned again, circumambulated the <s>Bhagavān</s> seven times, and disappeared into the crown of the <s>Bhagavān</s>'s head.

body.text: SaSū(C) 255

1. atha khalu bhaiṣajyaseno bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhagavantam etad avocat: pṛccheyam ahaṃ bhagavantaṃ tathāgatam arhantaṃ samyaksaṃbuddhaṃ kañcid eva pradeśaṃ, sacen me bhagavān avakāśaṃ kuryāt pṛṣṭapraśnavyākaraṇāya. 2. evam ukte bhagavāṃ bhaiṣajyasenaṃ bodhisatvaṃ mahāsatvam etad avocat: pṛccha tvaṃ bhaiṣajyasena yad yad evākāṃkṣasy; ahaṃ te tasya tasyaiva praśnasya vyākaraṇena cittam āradhayiṣyāmi.
body.translated_text: 1. Then the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s> said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'I would ask the <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, about a certain matter, if the <s>Bhagavān</s> would grant me the opportunity to have my question answered.' 2. When this was said, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said to the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva</s> <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>: 'Ask, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, whatever you wish; I shall satisfy your mind with the answer to each and every question.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 256
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 256

body.text:
1. evam ukte bhaiṣajyaseno bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhagavantam etad avocat: tṛṃśat koṭīsahasrāṇi bhagavan navakānāṃ satvānāṃ prādurbhūtāni. 2. te tathāgatasya sūkṣmān dharmadeśanām avagāhanti. 3. sūkṣmaṃ (dharmaṃ) bhagavan vṛddhāḥ satvā paribhāṣanti, parivadanti, paripīḍayanti. 4. na yūyaṃ vṛddhāḥ satvā dharmaṃ jānītha, nityaṃ yūyam adharme cākuśale ca rajyatha. 5. tad bhagavan mṛṣṭāṃ manāpāṃ vācaṃ bhāṣante. tat kena kāraṇena bhagavan vāvaṃ bhāṣante? 6. bhagavān āha: na vijānāsi bhaiṣajyasena kena kāraṇenaite satvā evaṃ vācaṃ bhāṣante? 7. tathāgatasyaibhir mṛdukaṃ sukumāraṃ bhāṣitaṃ dharmaṃ śrutvā tenaite bhaiṣajyasena sarvadharmāṇāṃ artham avabhotsyante, 8. sarvaguṇasamanvāgatāś ca bhaviṣyanti, 9. sarve ca dhāraṇīm avagāhiṣyanti. 10. adyadagreṇa daśabhūmipratiṣṭhitā bhaviṣyanti, 11. adya mahādharmadundubhiśabdaṃ prakariṣyanti, 12. adya mahādharmaprakārasamanvāgatā bhaviṣyanti. 13. paśyasi tvaṃ bhaiṣajyasena imāni kūṭāgārāṇi? 14. bhaiṣajyasena āha: paśyāmi bhagavan, paśyāmi sugata. 15. bhagavān āha: adyeme bhaiṣajyasena daharāḥ satvāḥ, eṣu kūṭāgāreṣv abhiruhya, dharmābhisamayam anuprāpsyanti, 16. adyeme sarvakuśaladharmaparipūriṃ kariṣyanti, 17. adya mahādharmadundubhiṃ parāhaniṣyanti, 18. anekeṣāṃ ca devanikāyānām adya dharmābhisamayo bhaviṣyati, 19. bahūnāñ ca nairayikānāṃ satvānāṃ vinipātasaṃprasthitānāṃ, tathāgatajñānanirdeśaṃ śrutvā, sarvasaṃsāraparāṅmukhaparājayo bhaviṣyati.
[SaSū(C) 257] 1. tasyām ca velāyāṃ vṛddhasatvair navānavatibhiḥ koṭīśasraiḥ srotaāpattiphalaṃ prāptaṃ. 2. te ca sarvadharmasamanvāgatā bhaviṣyanti, 3. sarve te bhaiṣajyasena sarvaduḥkhaparivarjitā bhaviṣyanti, 4. sarve te bhaiṣajyasena sarvatathāgatadarśanaṃ niṣpādayiṣyanti, 5. sarve te bhaiṣajyasena mahādharmasamanvāgatā bhaviṣyanti. 6. avalokaya bhaiṣajyasena caturdiśaṃ!
body.translated_text: (1) When this was said, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Bhaiṣajyasena</s> said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'Thirty thousand <s>koṭīs</s> of new beings have appeared, O <s>Bhagavān</s>. (2) They comprehend the subtle <s>Dharma</s> teaching of the <s>Tathāgata</s>. (3) The subtle <s>Dharma</s>, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, the old beings abuse, slander, and torment. (4) "You old beings do not know the <s>Dharma</s>; you are always attached to <s>adharma</s> and to what is unwholesome." (5) They speak pleasant, agreeable words, O <s>Bhagavān</s>. For what reason, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, do they speak thus?' (6) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Do you not understand, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, for what reason these beings speak such words? (7) Having heard the <s>Tathāgata</s>'s softly and delicately spoken <s>Dharma</s>, these beings, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, will comprehend the meaning of all <s>dharmas</s>. (8) They will become endowed with all virtues. (9) They will all enter into <s>dhāraṇī</s> (retention). (10) From this day forward they will be established on the ten <s>bhūmis</s> (stages). (11) Today they will produce the sound of the great <s>Dharma</s>-drum. (12) Today they will become endowed with great <s>Dharma</s>-modes. (13) Do you see, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, these pinnacled mansions (<s>kūṭāgāra</s>)?' (14) <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s> said: 'I see them, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, I see them, O <s>Sugata</s>.' (15) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Today, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, these young beings, having ascended to those mansions, will attain the comprehension of the <s>Dharma</s> (<s>dharmābhisamaya</s>). (16) Today they will accomplish the fulfillment of all wholesome <s>dharmas</s>. (17) Today they will strike the great <s>Dharma</s>-drum. (18) And today, for many classes of gods, there will be comprehension of the <s>Dharma</s>. (19) And for many beings dwelling in the hells, set on the course of downfall, having heard the teaching of the <s>Tathāgata</s>'s knowledge, there will be the defeat of turning away from all <s>saṃsāra</s>.' [SaSū(C) 257] (1) And at that moment, ninety-nine thousand <s>koṭīs</s> of old beings attained the fruit of <s>Srotaāpatti</s> (Stream-entry). (2) They will become endowed with all <s>dharmas</s>. (3) All of them, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, will be freed from all suffering. (4) All of them, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, will accomplish the seeing of all <s>Tathāgatas</s>. (5) All of them, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, will become endowed with the great <s>Dharma</s>. (6) 'Look, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, in the four directions!'

body.text: SaSū(C) 258
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 258

body.text: 1. avalokayati bhaiṣajyaseno bodhisatvo mahāsatvaḥ samantāc caturdiśaṃ: 2. pūrvasyān diśi paṃcāśatkoṭīgaṃgānadībālikāsamā bodhisatvā āgacchanti; 3. dakṣiṇasyān diśi ṣaṣṭikoṭīgaṃgānadībālikāsamā bodhisatvā āgacchanti; 4. paścimasyāṃ diśi saptatikoṭīgaṃgānadībālikāsamā bodhisatvā āgacchanti; 5. uttarasyān diśy aśītikoṭīgaṃgānadībālikāsamā bodhisatvā āgacchanti; 6. adhastāddiśi navatikoṭīsahasragaṃgānadībālikāsamā bodhisatvā āgacchanti; 7. ūrdhvāyāṃ diśi koṭīśatasahasragaṃgānadībālikāsamā bodhisatvā āgacchanti; 8. te cāgatāgatā bodhisatvā mahāsatvā, mahābhagavataḥ pādau śiraśābhivandya, ekānte tasthuḥ.
body.translated_text: (1) The <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Bhaiṣajyasena</s> looked in all four directions: (2) from the eastern direction, <s>Bodhisattvas</s> equal to the sands of fifty <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>Gaṅgā</s> Rivers come; (3) from the southern direction, <s>Bodhisattvas</s> equal to the sands of sixty <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>Gaṅgā</s> Rivers come; (4) from the western direction, <s>Bodhisattvas</s> equal to the sands of seventy <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>Gaṅgā</s> Rivers come; (5) from the northern direction, <s>Bodhisattvas</s> equal to the sands of eighty <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>Gaṅgā</s> Rivers come; (6) from the lower direction, <s>Bodhisattvas</s> equal to the sands of ninety thousand <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>Gaṅgā</s> Rivers come; (7) from the upper direction, <s>Bodhisattvas</s> equal to the sands of a hundred thousand <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>Gaṅgā</s> Rivers come. (8) And those <s>bodhisattva mahāsattvas</s>, having come, having bowed their heads at the feet of the great <s>Bhagavān</s>, stood to one side.

body.text: SaSū(C) 259
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 259

body.text: 1. ekāntasthitānāṃ daśadigbhya āgatānāṃ bodhisatvānāṃ mahāsatvānām, atha bhaiṣajyaseno bodhisatvo mahāsatvo bhagavantam etad avocat: 2. kim etad bhagavan khagāntarīkṣe kṛṣṇarūpaṃ lohitarūpaṃ ca paśyāmi? 3. bhagavān āha: kimidaṃ bhaiṣajyasena? na saṃjānāsi yad etad antarīkṣe kṛṣṇarūpaṃ lohitarūpaṃ ca paśyasi? 4. āha: na jānāmi bhagavan, na jānāmi sugata. 5. bhagavān āha: eṣa tathāgata eva jānāti: māro 'yaṃ bhaiṣajyasena vicakṣuskaraṇāyehopasaṃkrāntaḥ. 6. icchasi bhaiṣajyasenaitān bodhisatvān mahāsatvān draṣṭuṃ ya ete khagāntarīkṣe vyavasthitāḥ? 7. āha: icchāmi bhagavann, icchāmi sugata.
body.translated_text: (1) When the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattvas</s> who had come from the ten directions were standing to one side, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Bhaiṣajyasena</s> said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: (2) 'What is this, O <s>Bhagavān</s>? I see a dark form and a red form in the sky.' (3) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'What is this, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>? Do you not recognize what you see in the sky as a dark form and a red form?' (4) He said: 'I do not know, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, I do not know, O <s>Sugata</s>.' (5) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Only the <s>Tathāgata</s> knows this: this is <s>Māra</s>, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, who has approached here to deprive [beings] of sight. (6) Do you wish, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, to see those <s>bodhisattva mahāsattvas</s> who are stationed in the sky?' (7) He said: 'I wish to, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, I wish to, O <s>Sugata</s>.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 260
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 260

body.text: 1. atha bhagavāṃs, tān bodhisatvān darśayitvā, bhaiṣajyasenaṃ bodhisatvaṃ mahāsatvam āmantrayati sma: 2. īdṛśā bhaiṣajyasena gaṃgānadībālikāsamā bodhisatvā āgatāḥ. 3. āha: ko bhagavan hetuḥ kaḥ pratyayo yad ete bodhisatvā etāvanta ihāgatāḥ? 4. bhagavān āha: daharāṇāṃ satvānāṃ pratyayena bhaiṣajyasena saṃprātaṃ sarvasatvā dharmadhyānasamanvāgatā bhaviṣyanti. 5. paśyasi tvaṃ bhaiṣajyasena? bodhisatvā nānāṛddhibalā āgatā. 6. avalokitā mayā koṭīśatagaṃgānadībālikāsamā lokadhātavas; tatra mayā koṭīnayutaśatasahasragaṃgānadībālikāsamā bodhisatvā mahāsatvā dṛṣṭāḥ. 7. svakasvakena ṛddhibalena tiṣṭhanti, nānārūpā, nānāvarṇā, nānābalasaṃsthānās tiṣṭhanti. 8. āryadharmavihāreṣu te bodhisatvās tiṣṭhanti. dharmavihāreṣu te bodhisatvaparivārās tiṣṭhanti.
body.translated_text: (1) Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, having revealed those <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, addressed the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Bhaiṣajyasena</s>: (2) 'Such <s>Bodhisattvas</s>, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, equal to the sands of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>, have come.' (3) He said: 'What is the cause, O <s>Bhagavān</s>, what is the condition that so many <s>Bodhisattvas</s> have come here?' (4) The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Through the condition of the young beings, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, now all beings will become endowed with <s>Dharma</s>-meditation. (5) Do you see, <s>Bhaiṣajyasena</s>? <s>Bodhisattvas</s> with various supernatural powers (<s>ṛddhibala</s>) have come. (6) I have surveyed hundreds of <s>koṭīs</s> of <s>Gaṅgā</s>-sand world-systems; there I have seen <s>bodhisattva mahāsattvas</s> equal to hundreds of thousands of <s>koṭī-nayutas</s> of <s>Gaṅgā</s>-sands. (7) They stand by their own supernatural powers — of various forms, various colors, various configurations of strength. (8) Those <s>Bodhisattvas</s> abide in noble <s>Dharma</s>-dwellings. Those <s>Bodhisattva</s> retinues abide in <s>Dharma</s>-dwellings.'

body.text: SaSū(C) 260
body.translated_text: SaSū(C) 260

body.text: 1. idam avocad bhagavān āttamanāḥ. 2. sarvaśuro bodhisatvo mahāsatvaḥ, bhaiṣajyaseno bodhisatvo mahāsatvaḥ, sarve ca navapurāṇakā bodhisatvā mahāsatvāḥ, sā ca sarvāvatī parṣat, sadevamanuṣāsuragandharvaś ca loko bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandat. 3. 3. saṃghāṭaṃ nāma mahāyānasūtraṃ samāptam.
body.translated_text: (1) Thus spoke the <s>Bhagavān</s>, delighted. (2) The <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Sarvaśūra</s>, the <s>bodhisattva mahāsattva Bhaiṣajyasena</s>, all the new and old <s>bodhisattva mahāsattvas</s>, and the entire assembly, together with the world of gods, humans, <s>Asuras</s>, and <s>Gandharvas</s>, rejoiced at the words of the <s>Bhagavān</s>. (3) The <s>Mahāyāna</s> sūtra called <s>Saṃghāṭa</s> is completed.

body.text: Colophon D: // 0 // āryasaṃghāṭaṃ nāma dharmmaparyāyaṃ samāptam //0//
body.translated_text: [Colophon:] The <s>dharmaparyāya</s> (discourse) called the Noble <s>Saṃghāṭa</s> (<s>Ārya-saṃghāṭa</s>) is completed.
